peak 的文件输出是所有最大连续峰值区间，标准输出显示人数和两种时长；weighted-top10 的标准输出按总权重降序显示最多十个用户。命令不会自动创建输入父目录或工作目录，也不会把输入作为输出覆盖。需要处理更长记录或其他格式时，应同时修改解析契约、内存估算和对应测试。

怎样设计正确性测试

用可放进内存的小样本建立独立参考，再与外存实现逐项比较。数值参考可以用 long[] 排序；去重和交集参考可以用完整小集合；加权参考先在 Map 中以 BigInteger 累加全部用户，再按总权重和 user 排序。在线人数参考应在所有相邻端点区间内重新检查原始会话，用 Set 计算不同 userid 数，避免把生产事件扫描复制一遍后当作独立验证。

固定随机种子便于复现，但不能只依赖随机输入。还应明确列出空文件、单条、负数和数值极值、奇偶中位数、两中间值求和溢出、加权与频率相反的例子、第十名并列、跨批重复、只出现一次的 ID、哈希碰撞和 Unicode 键。同用户嵌套/重复会话、零长度会话、同刻上下线、多段并列峰值及成员更换但人数不变，要同时检查人数、全部最大连续区间、总时长和最长单段时长。

校验应覆盖完整结果：排序不仅要单调，还要保留每次出现且没有多出或漏掉记录；集合结果必须逐键相等；中位数要核对两个目标秩而不是只看一个近似均值。运行前后比较输入内容或摘要，确认没有修改原文件。测试参考中的全量数组和集合只适用于小样本，不能带入生产路径。

怎样验证内存和句柄确实有界

先减小 C、F，强制生成多批和多轮归并，再核对 Stats 的记录数、初始段数、归并轮数、最大批记录数和最大归并输入数。输入与结果文件应大于受限 Java 堆，避免一个实际上全部入内存的实现也轻易通过。变长键还要单独覆盖最长允许的 UTF-8 记录，不能用短数字通过测试就推断长字符串也安全。

EMBoundedStress 会流式生成倒序数据，并逐排名核对完整升序结果。它固定 C=4096、F=3；可用以下命令限制堆。支持 ulimit 的系统还可在子 shell 中约束文件描述符，不把限制遗留到当前交互 shell：

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
java -Xmx24m -cp classes EMBoundedStress 2000000
(ulimit -n 32; java -Xmx24m -cp classes EMBoundedStress 2000000)

这是一组可重复的资源检查参数，不是任何机器上的安全默认值。Java 堆上限不等于整个进程的物理内存上限；32 个描述符也包含 JVM 和标准输入输出等开销。应结合实际输入格式、文件系统、JVM 和进程预算调整参数，并检查任务结束后没有遗留属于该任务的临时段。

怎样测试失败路径

分别在解析、初始段写入、归并读取/写入、结果暂存、关闭和发布阶段注入失败。检查原始输入不变、旧目标不被半成品替换、已打开的流得到关闭、只清理当前任务拥有的目录。已有主要异常时，清理错误应保留在其 suppressed 链上；同一个异常对象被反复抛出时，附加前必须检查引用是否相同，避免自抑制又制造新的异常。目录遍历的 I/O 错误可能包装成 DirectoryIteratorException，也要纳入处理。

格式测试包括超长行、非法 UTF-8、孤立 CR/NUL、数字越界、字段缺失与非法区间。内部段中途截断和非法标记应报错；完整记录边界截断或合法格式的位翻转还需要额外条数/校验和机制才能可靠检测。原子发布只能避免读者看到半个新结果，不能替代 fsync、掉电耐久性、崩溃恢复、并发写者协调或一致输入快照。

最后应把小样本正确性、受限进程资源测试和生产容量/故障恢复测试分开。真实 10G、1TB、两个各 10 亿 URL 文件的耗时、磁盘空间和恢复能力，需要在相应环境中另外验证；通过前两类测试不能推出生产规模与所有故障场景都已得到保证。

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Dependency-free, record-bounded, fan-in-bounded external merge sort.
 * The caller owns input; Sorted owns only its newly created work directory.
 * Records must be immutable, of bounded size, and independent of a reused decoder buffer.
 */
public final class EMExternalSort {
    private EMExternalSort() {}
    public static final int BUFFER_BYTES = 8192;
    public record Limits(int chunkRecords, int fanIn) {
        public Limits {
            if (chunkRecords < 1 || fanIn < 2 || fanIn > 128)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("chunkRecords >= 1; 2 <= fanIn <= 128");
        }
    }
    @FunctionalInterface public interface Source<T> { T next() throws IOException; }
    public interface Codec<T> {
        void write(DataOutputStream out, T value) throws IOException;
        T read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException;
    }
    public record Stats(long records, long initialRuns, int mergePasses,
                        int maxChunkRecords, int maxMergeReaders) {}
    private static final class Counters {
        long records, initialRuns;
        int mergePasses, maxChunkRecords, maxMergeReaders;
        Stats freeze() { return new Stats(records, initialRuns, mergePasses,
                maxChunkRecords, maxMergeReaders); }
    }
    public static final class Cursor<T> implements AutoCloseable, Source<T> {
        private final DataInputStream in;
        private final Codec<T> codec;
        public Cursor(Path path, Codec<T> codec) throws IOException {
            this.codec = Objects.requireNonNull(codec);
            this.in = new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(
                    Files.newInputStream(path), BUFFER_BYTES));
        }
        public T next() throws IOException {
            int marker = in.read();
            if (marker == -1) return null;
            if (marker != 1) throw new IOException("invalid run record marker");
            T value = codec.read(in); // Truncation after marker must throw, never look like EOF.
            if (value == null) throw new IOException("null run record");
            return value;
        }
        public void close() throws IOException { in.close(); }
    }
    public static final class Sink<T> implements AutoCloseable {
        private final DataOutputStream out;
        private final Codec<T> codec;
        public Sink(Path path, Codec<T> codec) throws IOException {
            this.codec = Objects.requireNonNull(codec);
            this.out = new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(
                    Files.newOutputStream(path, StandardOpenOption.CREATE_NEW), BUFFER_BYTES));
        }
        public void add(T value) throws IOException {
            out.writeByte(1);
            codec.write(out, Objects.requireNonNull(value));
        }
        public void close() throws IOException { out.close(); }
    }
    public static final class Sorted<T> implements AutoCloseable {
        private final Path directory, file;
        private final Codec<T> codec;
        private final Stats stats;
        private boolean closed;
        private Sorted(Path directory, Path file, Codec<T> codec, Stats stats) {
            this.directory = directory; this.file = file; this.codec = codec; this.stats = stats;
        }
        public Stats stats() { return stats; }
        public Cursor<T> open() throws IOException {
            if (closed) throw new IOException("sorted result already closed");
            return new Cursor<>(file, codec);
        }
        public void close() throws IOException {
            if (!closed) { deleteOwnedDirectory(directory); closed = true; }
        }
    }
    /** Flat owned directory only; never follows directories/symlinks recursively. */
    public static void deleteOwnedDirectory(Path directory) throws IOException {
        IOException failure = null;
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> entries = Files.newDirectoryStream(directory)) {
            for (Path p : entries) {
                try { Files.deleteIfExists(p); }
                catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if (failure != e) failure.addSuppressed(e); }
            }
        } catch (DirectoryIteratorException e) {
            // Directory iteration wraps I/O failures in an unchecked exception.
            // Keep the wrapper too: try-with-resources may have attached close failures to it.
            IOException iterationFailure = new IOException("cannot iterate owned work directory", e);
            if (failure == null) failure = iterationFailure; else failure.addSuppressed(iterationFailure);
        } catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if (failure != e) failure.addSuppressed(e); }
        try { Files.deleteIfExists(directory); }
        catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if (failure != e) failure.addSuppressed(e); }
        if (failure != null) throw failure;
    }
    private static Path run(Path directory, int stage, long number) {
        return directory.resolve("stage-" + stage + "-run-" + number + ".bin");
    }
    public static <T> Sorted<T> sort(Source<T> input, Comparator<? super T> order,
                                    Codec<T> codec, Path workParent, Limits limits) throws IOException {
        Objects.requireNonNull(input); Objects.requireNonNull(order);
        Objects.requireNonNull(codec); Objects.requireNonNull(limits);
        Path work = Files.createTempDirectory(workParent, "em-sort-");
        try {
            Counters counters = new Counters();
            ArrayList<T> chunk = new ArrayList<>(Math.min(limits.chunkRecords(), 1024));
            long runs = 0;
            T value;
            while ((value = input.next()) != null) {
                chunk.add(value);
                counters.records = Math.incrementExact(counters.records);
                counters.maxChunkRecords = Math.max(counters.maxChunkRecords, chunk.size());
                if (chunk.size() == limits.chunkRecords()) {
                    flush(chunk, order, codec, run(work, 0, runs));
                    runs = Math.incrementExact(runs);
                }
            }
            if (!chunk.isEmpty()) {
                flush(chunk, order, codec, run(work, 0, runs));
                runs = Math.incrementExact(runs);
            }
            counters.initialRuns = runs;
            // Also represent an empty input by one valid empty run.
            if (runs == 0) { Files.createFile(run(work, 0, 0)); runs = 1; }
            int stage = 0;
            while (runs > 1) {
                long next = 0;
                for (long start = 0; start < runs;) {
                    ArrayList<Path> batch = new ArrayList<>(limits.fanIn());
                    for (int i = 0; i < limits.fanIn() && start < runs; i++, start++)
                        batch.add(run(work, stage, start));
                    counters.maxMergeReaders = Math.max(counters.maxMergeReaders, batch.size());
                    merge(batch, run(work, stage + 1, next), order, codec);
                    next = Math.incrementExact(next);
                    for (Path old : batch) Files.delete(old);
                }
                stage = Math.incrementExact(stage); runs = next;
            }
            counters.mergePasses = stage;
            return new Sorted<>(work, run(work, stage, 0), codec, counters.freeze());
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
            try { deleteOwnedDirectory(work); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if (failure != cleanup) failure.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            throw failure;
        }
    }
    private static <T> void flush(ArrayList<T> chunk, Comparator<? super T> order,
                                   Codec<T> codec, Path target) throws IOException {
        chunk.sort(order);
        try (Sink<T> out = new Sink<>(target, codec)) { for (T value : chunk) out.add(value); }
        chunk.clear();
    }
    private record Head<T>(T value, int source) {}
    private static final class Readers<T> implements AutoCloseable {
        final ArrayList<Cursor<T>> values = new ArrayList<>();
        public void close() throws IOException {
            IOException failure = null;
            for (Cursor<T> in : values) {
                try { in.close(); }
                catch (IOException e) { if (failure == null) failure = e; else if (failure != e) failure.addSuppressed(e); }
            }
            if (failure != null) throw failure;
        }
    }
    private static <T> void merge(List<Path> inputs, Path target,
                                   Comparator<? super T> order, Codec<T> codec) throws IOException {
        Comparator<Head<T>> headOrder = (a, b) -> {
            int c = order.compare(a.value(), b.value());
            return c != 0 ? c : Integer.compare(a.source(), b.source());
        };
        PriorityQueue<Head<T>> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(headOrder);
        try (Readers<T> readers = new Readers<>(); Sink<T> out = new Sink<>(target, codec)) {
            for (Path input : inputs) {
                Cursor<T> in = new Cursor<>(input, codec);
                readers.values.add(in);
                T first = in.next();
                if (first != null) heap.add(new Head<>(first, readers.values.size() - 1));
            }
            while (!heap.isEmpty()) {
                Head<T> head = heap.remove();
                out.add(head.value());
                T next = readers.values.get(head.source()).next();
                if (next != null) heap.add(new Head<>(next, head.source()));
            }
        }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.*;
import java.nio.charset.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** UTF-8 contracts and atomic output staging shared by the examples. */
public final class EMIO {
    private EMIO() {}
    public static final int MAX_LINE_BYTES = 32768;
    public static String decode(byte[] bytes) throws CharacterCodingException {
        return StandardCharsets.UTF_8.newDecoder()
                .onMalformedInput(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .onUnmappableCharacter(CodingErrorAction.REPORT)
                .decode(ByteBuffer.wrap(bytes)).toString();
    }
    public static final class Lines implements AutoCloseable, EMExternalSort.Source<String> {
        private final InputStream in;
        private final byte[] bytes = new byte[MAX_LINE_BYTES + 1];
        public Lines(Path path) throws IOException {
            in = new BufferedInputStream(Files.newInputStream(path), EMExternalSort.BUFFER_BYTES);
        }
        public String next() throws IOException {
            int n = 0, c;
            while ((c = in.read()) != -1 && c != '\n') {
                if (n == bytes.length) throw new IOException("record exceeds byte limit");
                bytes[n++] = (byte)c;
            }
            if (c == -1 && n == 0) return null;
            if (c == '\n' && n > 0 && bytes[n - 1] == '\r') n--;
            if (n > MAX_LINE_BYTES) throw new IOException("record exceeds byte limit");
            String value = decode(Arrays.copyOf(bytes, n));
            if (value.indexOf('\r') >= 0 || value.indexOf('\0') >= 0)
                throw new IOException("embedded CR/NUL or unterminated CR is not supported");
            return value;
        }
        public void close() throws IOException { in.close(); }
    }
    public static String key(String s) throws IOException {
        if (s.isEmpty()) throw new IOException("empty ID/URL/user");
        return s; // No trim, case folding, Unicode or URL normalization.
    }
    public static long decimal(String s, boolean nonnegative) throws IOException {
        if (s.isEmpty()) throw new IOException("empty integer");
        int start = s.charAt(0) == '-' || s.charAt(0) == '+' ? 1 : 0;
        if (start == s.length()) throw new IOException("integer has no digits");
        for (int i = start; i < s.length(); i++)
            if (s.charAt(i) < '0' || s.charAt(i) > '9') throw new IOException("invalid decimal integer");
        try {
            long value = Long.parseLong(s);
            if (nonnegative && value < 0) throw new IOException("negative integer");
            return value;
        } catch (NumberFormatException e) { throw new IOException("integer outside signed long range", e); }
    }
    public static void writeString(DataOutputStream out, String value) throws IOException {
        byte[] bytes = value.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
        if (bytes.length > MAX_LINE_BYTES) throw new IOException("key too long");
        out.writeInt(bytes.length); out.write(bytes);
    }
    public static String readString(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
        int length = in.readInt();
        if (length < 0 || length > MAX_LINE_BYTES) throw new IOException("invalid run string length");
        byte[] bytes = new byte[length]; in.readFully(bytes); return decode(bytes);
    }
    public static final EMExternalSort.Codec<String> STRINGS = new EMExternalSort.Codec<>() {
        public void write(DataOutputStream out, String value) throws IOException { writeString(out, value); }
        public String read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException { return readString(in); }
    };
    public static final EMExternalSort.Codec<Long> LONGS = new EMExternalSort.Codec<>() {
        public void write(DataOutputStream out, Long value) throws IOException { out.writeLong(value); }
        public Long read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException { return in.readLong(); }
    };
    @FunctionalInterface public interface OutputAction { void write(BufferedWriter out) throws IOException; }
    public static void separateOutput(Path output, Path... inputs) throws IOException {
        Path normalized = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        for (Path input : inputs)
            if (normalized.equals(input.toAbsolutePath().normalize()) ||
                    (Files.exists(output) && Files.isSameFile(output, input)))
                throw new IOException("output aliases an input");
    }
    /** Same-filesystem atomic move required; unsupported providers fail, no non-atomic fallback.
     * Replacement of an existing target under ATOMIC_MOVE is provider-specific.
     * Atomic publication is not a power-loss durability/fsync or crash-resume guarantee.
     */
    public static void atomicText(Path output, OutputAction action) throws IOException {
        Path target = output.toAbsolutePath().normalize();
        Path stage = Files.createTempFile(target.getParent(), ".em-output-", ".tmp");
        try {
            try (BufferedWriter out = Files.newBufferedWriter(stage, StandardCharsets.UTF_8)) { action.write(out); }
            Files.move(stage, target, StandardCopyOption.ATOMIC_MOVE, StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
            try { Files.deleteIfExists(stage); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if (failure != cleanup) failure.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            throw failure;
        }
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;
import java.nio.file.*;

/** One signed 64-bit decimal integer per UTF-8 line. Numeric duplicates are retained. */
public final class EMNumeric {
    private EMNumeric() {}
    public record Median(long lower, long upper) {
        public BigDecimal exact() {
            return new BigDecimal(BigInteger.valueOf(lower).add(BigInteger.valueOf(upper)))
                    .divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(2));
        }
    }
    static EMExternalSort.Sorted<Long> ordered(Path input, Path work,
                                               EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        EMExternalSort.Sorted<Long> result = null;
        try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input)) {
            result = EMExternalSort.sort(() -> {
                String line = lines.next();
                return line == null ? null : EMIO.decimal(line, false);
            }, Long::compare, EMIO.LONGS, work, limits);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
            if (result != null) {
                try { result.close(); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if (failure != cleanup) failure.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            }
            throw failure;
        }
        return result;
    }
    public static EMExternalSort.Stats sortFile(Path input, Path output, Path work,
                                                EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        EMIO.separateOutput(output, input);
        try (EMExternalSort.Sorted<Long> sorted = ordered(input, work, limits)) {
            EMIO.atomicText(output, out -> {
                try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<Long> cursor = sorted.open()) {
                    Long value;
                    while ((value = cursor.next()) != null) { out.write(Long.toString(value)); out.newLine(); }
                }
            });
            return sorted.stats();
        }
    }
    public static Median median(Path input, Path work, EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        try (EMExternalSort.Sorted<Long> sorted = ordered(input, work, limits)) {
            long n = sorted.stats().records();
            if (n == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty input has no median");
            long lowerRank = (n - 1) / 2, upperRank = n / 2;
            long lower = 0, upper = 0;
            try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<Long> cursor = sorted.open()) {
                for (long i = 0; i <= upperRank; i++) {
                    Long value = cursor.next();
                    if (value == null) throw new EOFException("run ended before median rank");
                    if (i == lowerRank) lower = value;
                    if (i == upperRank) upper = value;
                }
            }
            return new Median(lower, upper);
        }
    }
    /** Exact signed-long radix selection: count pass + eight full input passes.
     * Requires an immutable input snapshot throughout all passes.
     * Two 256-counter histograms track the two median order statistics together.
     */
    public static Median radixMedian(Path input) throws IOException {
        long n = 0;
        try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input)) {
            String line;
            while ((line = lines.next()) != null) {
                EMIO.decimal(line, false); n = Math.incrementExact(n);
            }
        }
        if (n == 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("empty input has no median");
        long lowRank = (n - 1) / 2, highRank = n / 2;
        long lowPrefix = 0, highPrefix = 0, mask = 0;
        for (int shift = 56; shift >= 0; shift -= 8) {
            long[] lowCounts = new long[256], highCounts = new long[256];
            boolean shared = lowPrefix == highPrefix;
            long seen = 0;
            try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input)) {
                String line;
                while ((line = lines.next()) != null) {
                    long ordered = EMIO.decimal(line, false) ^ Long.MIN_VALUE;
                    int bucket = (int)((ordered >>> shift) & 255);
                    if ((ordered & mask) == lowPrefix) lowCounts[bucket] = Math.incrementExact(lowCounts[bucket]);
                    if (!shared && (ordered & mask) == highPrefix) highCounts[bucket] = Math.incrementExact(highCounts[bucket]);
                    seen = Math.incrementExact(seen);
                }
            }
            if (seen != n) throw new IOException("input count changed between passes");
            if (shared) highCounts = lowCounts;
            Selection low = selectBucket(lowCounts, lowRank), high = selectBucket(highCounts, highRank);
            lowRank = low.rank(); highRank = high.rank();
            lowPrefix |= ((long)low.bucket()) << shift;
            highPrefix |= ((long)high.bucket()) << shift;
            mask |= 255L << shift;
        }
        return new Median(lowPrefix ^ Long.MIN_VALUE, highPrefix ^ Long.MIN_VALUE);
    }
    private record Selection(int bucket, long rank) {}
    private static Selection selectBucket(long[] counts, long rank) throws IOException {
        for (int bucket = 0; bucket < counts.length; bucket++) {
            if (rank < counts[bucket]) return new Selection(bucket, rank);
            rank -= counts[bucket];
        }
        throw new IOException("rank missing; source may have changed");
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Weighted user popularity: user<TAB>action<TAB>timestamp<TAB>count.
 * count is a nonnegative signed-long input; total is an exact BigInteger.
 */
public final class EMWeightedTop {
    private EMWeightedTop() {}
    public record Log(String user, String action, long timestamp, long count) {
        public Log {
            Objects.requireNonNull(user); Objects.requireNonNull(action);
            if (user.isEmpty() || action.isEmpty() || timestamp < 0 || count < 0)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid log fields");
        }
    }
    public record Weight(String user, long count) {}
    public record Total(String user, BigInteger count) {}
    public static final Comparator<Total> BEST = Comparator.comparing(Total::count).reversed()
            .thenComparing(Total::user);
    /** A mapper emits count, not the constant one. */
    public static Weight map(Log log) { return new Weight(log.user(), log.count()); }
    /** One complete user's values; iterable must stream and must not contain other users. */
    public static Total reduce(String user, Iterable<Long> values) {
        BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO;
        for (long value : values) {
            if (value < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative count");
            total = total.add(BigInteger.valueOf(value));
        }
        return new Total(user, total);
    }
    public static final class TopK {
        private final int k;
        private final PriorityQueue<Total> heap = new PriorityQueue<>(BEST.reversed());
        public TopK(int k) { if (k < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative k"); this.k = k; }
        public void add(Total value) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(value);
            if (k == 0) return;
            if (heap.size() < k) heap.add(value);
            else if (BEST.compare(value, heap.peek()) < 0) { heap.remove(); heap.add(value); }
        }
        public List<Total> result() {
            ArrayList<Total> result = new ArrayList<>(heap); result.sort(BEST); return result;
        }
    }
    static Log parse(String line) throws IOException {
        String[] fields = line.split("\t", -1);
        if (fields.length != 4) throw new IOException("expected user/action/timestamp/count TSV fields");
        return new Log(EMIO.key(fields[0]), EMIO.key(fields[1]),
                EMIO.decimal(fields[2], true), EMIO.decimal(fields[3], true));
    }
    private static final EMExternalSort.Codec<Weight> CODEC = new EMExternalSort.Codec<>() {
        public void write(DataOutputStream out, Weight value) throws IOException {
            EMIO.writeString(out, value.user()); out.writeLong(value.count());
        }
        public Weight read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
            String user = EMIO.readString(in); long count = in.readLong();
            if (count < 0) throw new IOException("negative run count"); return new Weight(user, count);
        }
    };
    /** Single-machine executable counterpart to shuffle/group/reduce + TopK.
     * It does not instantiate Hadoop or claim to exercise distributed retries.
     */
    public static List<Total> top(Path input, Path work, EMExternalSort.Limits limits, int k)
            throws IOException {
        try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input);
             EMExternalSort.Sorted<Weight> sorted = EMExternalSort.sort(() -> {
                 String line = lines.next(); return line == null ? null : map(parse(line));
             }, Comparator.comparing(Weight::user), CODEC, work, limits);
             EMExternalSort.Cursor<Weight> cursor = sorted.open()) {
            TopK top = new TopK(k);
            String user = null; BigInteger sum = BigInteger.ZERO;
            Weight value;
            while ((value = cursor.next()) != null) {
                if (user != null && !user.equals(value.user())) {
                    top.add(new Total(user, sum)); sum = BigInteger.ZERO;
                }
                user = value.user(); sum = sum.add(BigInteger.valueOf(value.count()));
            }
            if (user != null) top.add(new Total(user, sum));
            return top.result();
        }
    }

import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Exact global distinct export and set intersection, not duplicate-only reporting. */
public final class EMStrings {
    private EMStrings() {}
    private static EMExternalSort.Sorted<String> ordered(Path input, Path work,
                                                        EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        EMExternalSort.Sorted<String> result = null;
        try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input)) {
            result = EMExternalSort.sort(() -> {
                String line = lines.next(); return line == null ? null : EMIO.key(line);
            }, Comparator.naturalOrder(), EMIO.STRINGS, work, limits);
        } catch (IOException | RuntimeException | Error failure) {
            if (result != null) {
                try { result.close(); } catch (IOException cleanup) { if (failure != cleanup) failure.addSuppressed(cleanup); }
            }
            throw failure;
        }
        return result;
    }
    /** Writes every different ID once, including IDs whose input count was one. */
    public static long distinct(Path input, Path output, Path work,
                                 EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        EMIO.separateOutput(output, input);
        long[] written = {0};
        try (EMExternalSort.Sorted<String> sorted = ordered(input, work, limits)) {
            EMIO.atomicText(output, out -> {
                try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<String> cursor = sorted.open()) {
                    String previous = null, value;
                    while ((value = cursor.next()) != null) {
                        if (!value.equals(previous)) {
                            out.write(value); out.newLine();
                            written[0] = Math.incrementExact(written[0]); previous = value;
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        return written[0];
    }
    /** Each common URL is written once. Equality is the complete decoded string. */
    public static long intersection(Path left, Path right, Path output, Path work,
                                     EMExternalSort.Limits limits) throws IOException {
        EMIO.separateOutput(output, left, right);
        long[] written = {0};
        try (EMExternalSort.Sorted<String> a = ordered(left, work, limits);
             EMExternalSort.Sorted<String> b = ordered(right, work, limits)) {
            EMIO.atomicText(output, out -> {
                try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<String> ca = a.open(); EMExternalSort.Cursor<String> cb = b.open()) {
                    String x = ca.next(), y = cb.next();
                    while (x != null && y != null) {
                        int compare = x.compareTo(y);
                        if (compare < 0) x = ca.next();
                        else if (compare > 0) y = cb.next();
                        else {
                            out.write(x); out.newLine(); written[0] = Math.incrementExact(written[0]);
                            String equal = x;
                            do { x = ca.next(); } while (equal.equals(x));
                            do { y = cb.next(); } while (equal.equals(y));
                        }
                    }
                }
            });
        }
        return written[0];
    }
}

import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.util.*;

/** Distinct-user online peak from user<TAB>login<TAB>logout intervals.
 * Times are nonnegative long ticks; intervals are half-open [login,logout).
 */
public final class EMPeakOnline {
    private EMPeakOnline() {}
    public record Session(String user, long start, long end) {
        public Session {
            Objects.requireNonNull(user);
            if (user.isEmpty() || start < 0 || end < start) throw new IllegalArgumentException("invalid session");
        }
    }
    private record Event(long time, long delta) {}
    public record Peak(long users, BigInteger totalDuration, BigInteger longestContinuous,
                       long intervals) {}
    private static final EMExternalSort.Codec<Session> SESSIONS = new EMExternalSort.Codec<>() {
        public void write(DataOutputStream out, Session value) throws IOException {
            EMIO.writeString(out, value.user()); out.writeLong(value.start()); out.writeLong(value.end());
        }
        public Session read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
            return new Session(EMIO.readString(in), in.readLong(), in.readLong());
        }
    };
    private static final EMExternalSort.Codec<Event> EVENTS = new EMExternalSort.Codec<>() {
        public void write(DataOutputStream out, Event value) throws IOException {
            out.writeLong(value.time()); out.writeLong(value.delta());
        }
        public Event read(DataInputStream in) throws IOException {
            long time = in.readLong(), delta = in.readLong();
            if (time < 0 || (delta != -1 && delta != 1)) throw new IOException("invalid event");
            return new Event(time, delta);
        }
    };
    private static Session parse(String line) throws IOException {
        String[] f = line.split("\t", -1);
        if (f.length != 3) throw new IOException("expected user/login/logout TSV fields");
        long start = EMIO.decimal(f[1], true), end = EMIO.decimal(f[2], true);
        if (end < start) throw new IOException("logout precedes login");
        return new Session(EMIO.key(f[0]), start, end);
    }
    private static final class OwnedDirectory implements AutoCloseable {
        final Path path;
        OwnedDirectory(Path parent) throws IOException { path = Files.createTempDirectory(parent, "em-peak-"); }
        public void close() throws IOException { EMExternalSort.deleteOwnedDirectory(path); }
    }
    /** Writes maximal contiguous peak spans as start<TAB>end, one span per line.
     * Empty/all-zero-length input: peak=0, no output spans, both durations=0.
     */
    public static Peak calculate(Path input, Path peakOutput, Path work, EMExternalSort.Limits limits)
            throws IOException {
        EMIO.separateOutput(peakOutput, input);
        try (OwnedDirectory owned = new OwnedDirectory(work)) {
            Path events = owned.path.resolve("union-events.bin");
            try (EMIO.Lines lines = new EMIO.Lines(input);
                 EMExternalSort.Sorted<Session> sorted = EMExternalSort.sort(() -> {
                     String line = lines.next(); return line == null ? null : parse(line);
                 }, Comparator.comparing(Session::user).thenComparingLong(Session::start)
                         .thenComparingLong(Session::end), SESSIONS, work, limits);
                 EMExternalSort.Cursor<Session> cursor = sorted.open();
                 EMExternalSort.Sink<Event> out = new EMExternalSort.Sink<>(events, EVENTS)) {
                Session pending = null, session;
                while ((session = cursor.next()) != null) {
                    if (session.start() == session.end()) continue;
                    if (pending != null && pending.user().equals(session.user()) && session.start() <= pending.end()) {
                        pending = new Session(pending.user(), pending.start(), Math.max(pending.end(), session.end()));
                    } else {
                        if (pending != null) emit(pending, out);
                        pending = session;
                    }
                }
                if (pending != null) emit(pending, out);
            }
            try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<Event> source = new EMExternalSort.Cursor<>(events, EVENTS);
                 EMExternalSort.Sorted<Event> sorted = EMExternalSort.sort(source, Comparator.comparingLong(Event::time),
                         EVENTS, work, limits)) {
                long[] peak = {0};
                visitSegments(sorted, (start, end, count) -> peak[0] = Math.max(peak[0], count));
                Peak[] result = new Peak[1];
                EMIO.atomicText(peakOutput, out -> {
                    PeakWriter writer = new PeakWriter(out, peak[0]);
                    visitSegments(sorted, writer::segment);
                    result[0] = writer.finish();
                });
                return result[0];
            }
        }
    }
    private static void emit(Session s, EMExternalSort.Sink<Event> out) throws IOException {
        out.add(new Event(s.start(), 1)); out.add(new Event(s.end(), -1));
    }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface SegmentHandler {
        void accept(long start, long end, long users) throws IOException;
    }
    private static void visitSegments(EMExternalSort.Sorted<Event> sorted, SegmentHandler handler)
            throws IOException {
        try (EMExternalSort.Cursor<Event> cursor = sorted.open()) {
            Event next = cursor.next();
            if (next == null) return;
            long previous = next.time(), active = 0;
            while (next != null) {
                long time = next.time();
                if (time > previous) handler.accept(previous, time, active);
                long delta = 0;
                do {
                    delta = Math.addExact(delta, next.delta()); next = cursor.next();
                } while (next != null && next.time() == time);
                active = Math.addExact(active, delta);
                if (active < 0) throw new IOException("negative active-user count");
                previous = time;
            }
            if (active != 0) throw new IOException("unbalanced events");
        }
    }
    private static final class PeakWriter {
        final BufferedWriter out;
        final long peak;
        boolean open;
        long start, end, intervals;
        BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO, longest = BigInteger.ZERO;
        PeakWriter(BufferedWriter out, long peak) { this.out = out; this.peak = peak; }
        void segment(long a, long b, long count) throws IOException {
            if (peak > 0 && count == peak) {
                if (open && end == a) { end = b; return; }
                flush(); open = true; start = a; end = b;
            } else flush();
        }
        void flush() throws IOException {
            if (!open) return;
            out.write(Long.toString(start)); out.write('\t'); out.write(Long.toString(end)); out.newLine();
            BigInteger duration = BigInteger.valueOf(end).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(start));
            total = total.add(duration); longest = longest.max(duration);
            intervals = Math.incrementExact(intervals); open = false;
        }
        Peak finish() throws IOException { flush(); return new Peak(peak, total, longest, intervals); }
    }
}

public final class EMAlgorithmsTest {
    private static int checks;

    private static void check(boolean condition, String message) {
        checks++; if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(message);
    }
    @FunctionalInterface private interface Action { void run() throws Exception; }
    private static void rejects(Action action, Class<? extends Throwable> kind) throws Exception {
        try { action.run(); throw new AssertionError("expected " + kind); }
        catch (Throwable failure) {
            if (!kind.isInstance(failure)) throw failure;
            checks++;
        }
    }
    private static void cleanWork(Path base) throws IOException {
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> files = Files.newDirectoryStream(base)) {
            for (Path p : files) {
                String name = p.getFileName().toString();
                check(!name.startsWith("em-sort-") && !name.startsWith("em-peak-") && !name.startsWith(".em-output-"),
                        "temporary path leaked: " + name);
            }
        }
    }
    private static void numeric(Path base) throws Exception {
        Path input = base.resolve("numbers.txt"), output = base.resolve("numbers-out.txt");
        Random random = new Random(147159417L);

            int n = test == 0 ? 0 : test == 1 ? 1 : 2 + random.nextInt(450);
            long[] oracle = new long[n]; StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                long value = i % 31 == 0 ? Long.MIN_VALUE : i % 37 == 0 ? Long.MAX_VALUE :
                        test % 4 == 0 ? random.nextLong() : random.nextInt(43) - 21;
                oracle[i] = value; text.append(value).append(i % 2 == 0 ? "\r\n" : "\n");
            }

            List<String> actual = Files.readAllLines(output);

            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) check(Long.parseLong(actual.get(i)) == oracle[i], "numeric sort");
            check(stats.records() == n && stats.maxChunkRecords() <= 7 && stats.maxMergeReaders() <= 3, "sort bounds");
            if (n > 63) check(stats.mergePasses() >= 3, "multi-pass exercised");
            if (n == 0) {

                rejects(() -> EMNumeric.radixMedian(input), IllegalArgumentException.class);

        for (var s : sessions) { endpoints.add(s.start()); endpoints.add(s.end()); }
        List<Long> times = new ArrayList<>(endpoints); List<Long> counts = new ArrayList<>(); long peak = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i + 1 < times.size(); i++) {
            long point = times.get(i); Set<String> active = new HashSet<>();
            for (var s : sessions) if (s.start() <= point && point < s.end()) active.add(s.user());
            long count = active.size(); counts.add(count); peak = Math.max(peak, count);
        }
        List<String> intervals = new ArrayList<>(); BigInteger total = BigInteger.ZERO, longest = BigInteger.ZERO;
        for (int i = 0; i < counts.size();) {
            if (peak == 0 || counts.get(i) != peak) { i++; continue; }
            long start = times.get(i), end = times.get(i + 1); i++;
            while (i < counts.size() && counts.get(i) == peak) { end = times.get(i + 1); i++; }
            intervals.add(start + "\t" + end);
            BigInteger d = BigInteger.valueOf(end).subtract(BigInteger.valueOf(start)); total = total.add(d); longest = longest.max(d);
        }
        return new PeakOracle(peak, intervals, total, longest);
    }
    private static void onePeak(Path base, List<EMPeakOnline.Session> sessions) throws Exception {
        Path input = base.resolve("sessions.txt"), output = base.resolve("peaks.txt");
        StringBuilder text = new StringBuilder();
        for (var s : sessions) text.append(s.user()).append('\t').append(s.start()).append('\t').append(s.end()).append('\n');
        Files.writeString(input, text); byte[] before = Files.readAllBytes(input);
        PeakOracle want = brutePeak(sessions); EMPeakOnline.Peak actual = EMPeakOnline.calculate(input, output, base, TINY);
        check(actual.users() == want.peak() && actual.intervals() == want.intervals().size(), "distinct-user peak");
        check(actual.totalDuration().equals(want.total()) && actual.longestContinuous().equals(want.longest()), "peak durations");
        check(Files.readAllLines(output).equals(want.intervals()), "all maximal peak spans");
        check(Arrays.equals(before, Files.readAllBytes(input)), "session source unchanged"); cleanWork(base);
    }
    private static void peaks(Path base) throws Exception {
        Random random = new Random(161L);
        onePeak(base, List.of());
        onePeak(base, List.of(new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 0, 0)));
        onePeak(base, List.of(new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 0, 10), new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 2, 8),
                new EMPeakOnline.Session("b", 5, 15), new EMPeakOnline.Session("b", 15, 20),
                new EMPeakOnline.Session("c", 15, 18), new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 0, 10)));
        onePeak(base, List.of(new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 0, 3), new EMPeakOnline.Session("b", 3, 6)));
        onePeak(base, List.of(new EMPeakOnline.Session("a", 0, Long.MAX_VALUE)));
        for (int test = 0; test < 160; test++) {
            List<EMPeakOnline.Session> sessions = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0, n = random.nextInt(160); i < n; i++) {
                long start = random.nextInt(50), end = start + random.nextInt(15);
                sessions.add(new EMPeakOnline.Session("u" + random.nextInt(15), start, end));
            }
            Collections.shuffle(sessions, random); onePeak(base, sessions);
        }
        Path input = base.resolve("sessions.txt"), output = base.resolve("peaks.txt");
        for (String bad : List.of("a\t10\t2\n", "a\t-1\t2\n", "a\t0\t\n", "a\t0\t2\textra\n")) {
            Files.writeString(input, bad); Files.writeString(output, "KEEP");
            rejects(() -> EMPeakOnline.calculate(input, output, base, TINY), IOException.class);
            check(Files.readString(output).equals("KEEP"), "invalid interval preserves output"); cleanWork(base);
        }
    }
    private static void failures(Path base) throws Exception {
        rejects(() -> new EMExternalSort.Limits(0, 3), IllegalArgumentException.class);
        rejects(() -> new EMExternalSort.Limits(1, 129), IllegalArgumentException.class);
        int[] i = {0}; IOException sentinel = new IOException("injected source failure");
        try {
            EMExternalSort.sort(() -> { if (i[0]++ == 25) throw sentinel; return 25L - i[0]; },
                    Long::compare, EMIO.LONGS, base, TINY);
            throw new AssertionError("source injection ignored");
        } catch (IOException failure) { check(failure == sentinel, "original exception preserved"); }
        cleanWork(base);
        Path broken = base.resolve("truncated.bin");
        Files.write(broken, new byte[]{1, 0, 0});
        try (var cursor = new EMExternalSort.Cursor<>(broken, EMIO.LONGS)) {
            rejects(cursor::next, EOFException.class);
        }
        Path output = base.resolve("atomic.txt"); Files.writeString(output, "KEEP");
        rejects(() -> EMIO.atomicText(output, out -> { out.write("partial"); throw new IOException("injected sink failure"); }), IOException.class);
        check(Files.readString(output).equals("KEEP"), "partial sink not published"); cleanWork(base);
        Path nonempty = base.resolve("output-directory"); Files.createDirectory(nonempty);
        Files.writeString(nonempty.resolve("keep"), "KEEP");
        rejects(() -> EMIO.atomicText(nonempty, out -> out.write("new")), IOException.class);
        check(Files.readString(nonempty.resolve("keep")).equals("KEEP"), "commit failure preserves target");
        Files.delete(nonempty.resolve("keep")); Files.delete(nonempty); cleanWork(base);
    }
    private static void remove(Path base) throws IOException {
        try (DirectoryStream<Path> files = Files.newDirectoryStream(base)) {
            for (Path file : files) Files.delete(file);
        }
        Files.delete(base);
    }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Path base = Files.createTempDirectory("em-tests-");
        try {
            numeric(base); strings(base); weighted(base); peaks(base); failures(base);
            System.out.println("PASS " + checks + " assertions; fixed seeds; 100 numeric+radix cases, 90 distinct/intersection cases,");
            System.out.println("100 weighted cases (4 k values + reducer candidates), 165 independent endpoint/Set peak references;");
            System.out.println("multi-pass fan-in3, source preservation, singleton/hash-collision/Unicode/extreme/tie cases, malformed input, atomic failure and cleanup.");
        } finally { remove(base); }
    }
}

Session平均时长 先配对事件再确定分母

用Map<user,loginTime>配对并累计完成会话时长，同时返回三种不同指标：全部Session等权平均、先求各用户Session均值再让用户等权平均、每用户累计在线时长的平均。没有有效完成会话时返回缺失值而不是0；缺失的会话ID使并发设备会话无法唯一配对。

可能的问法

  • 日志只有 Timestamp、User ID、Operation 三列，Operation 为 login 或 logout，怎样计算平均 Session 在线时长？
  • 说明时间、空间复杂度，并讨论海量流式输入、乱序和未配对事件的容错边界；平均的分母又应怎样确定？

输入、输出与前提

日志平均时长需先约定时间格式、重叠会话、异常处理和平均口径。下面 timestampMillis 为非负 long 毫秒时间戳，每用户同时至多一个活动会话；先按事件时间稳定排序，同时间沿输入顺序。重复 login 保留最早未关闭登录并记异常，孤立 logout 跳过并记异常，末尾未配对 login 不计完成会话并报告数量。

为什么这样做

“平均会话时长”首先要说清分母，不同分母算的是不同指标。设用户 u 有 c_u 个完成会话，总时长 D_u：

  • 按 Session 平均：ΣD_u/Σc_u，每个完成会话权重相同。
  • 先算每个用户的平均 Session 时长，再按用户平均：(Σ(D_u/c_u))/U，每个用户权重相同。
  • 按用户平均总在线时长：ΣD_u/U，不再除以各自会话数。

这里 U 只包含至少有一个有效完成会话的用户。如果要包含所有注册用户或观察窗口内用户，还必须提供用户全集和边界口径。

例如A有10和30毫秒两个会话，B有100毫秒一个会话，三种结果分别140/3≈46.67、(20+100)/2=60、140/2=70。直接对所有用户平均值再求平均会改变权重，不能把60当作每Session平均；合并分片时也应合并总时长与次数，不能对不同样本量分片的均值直接平均。

按时间遍历时，不变量是active仅保存尚未关闭且被当前异常策略接纳的登录。logout与相应起点配对后删除active条目，把duration加入该用户和全局累计并加一次计数。重复login、孤立logout各有单独指标，不参与偷偷造出的会话。已排序且时间非负，因此duration在0..Long.MAX_VALUE；总时长用BigInteger以免大量合法时长相加溢出。

BigDecimal以DECIMAL128求平均，分数可能无限循环，展示值是有明确精度的近似；Result仍保留精确BigInteger总数和会话计数，可随时按另一精度重算。按用户均值再平均会先在每个用户处发生一次DECIMAL128舍入，不能称作任意精度精确有理数结果。

相同时间 login/logout 的次序影响配对：logout 在前会记孤立，随后 login 留为未关闭；login 在前可得到 0 时长。只有时间戳、用户、动作三列无法可靠识别重放、跨设备会话或漏失 logout，生产应增加 eventId/sessionId 与可靠顺序定义。当前接口稳定保持相同时间的输入次序。

事件乱序到什么程度，决定了能不能直接流式配对。批量输入可以先排序，成本是 O(N log N) 时间、O(N) 额外数据；已经按每个用户的事件时间有序，就能直接消费，主要保存未关闭用户和累计值，状态为 O(U)。

如果允许无限迟到，就不能同时承诺有限内存、有限等待和全部精确配对：一个很早的 login 可能任意晚才来。必须约定允许迟到时间、保留期，或者改用外部排序。

水位线决定哪些事件时间范围可以最终化，TTL 只决定状态保留多久，两者不能代替真实 logout。流处理可以按 user/sessionId 分区，在水位线约束下缓冲排序，水位线之前再最终化；超限迟到事件走旁路、补算，或发撤回/更正。

用“超时上限”补一个结束时间，属于业务估计，要和实际 logout 配对的结果分开。作业重试还需要检查点与幂等 sink，否则同一个完成会话可能被重复累计。

跨统计日的会话可以完整归到结束日，或裁剪至窗口交集，或归到开始日，结果不同。跨时区应先规范到时间线；持续时长不能用可跳变的本地钟显示字符串直接相减。当前代码是有限批量内的确定配对器，没有运行Flink、分布式checkpoint或生产日志集成。

例子与推演

生成多用户合法会话并打乱顺序，逐项检查精确总时长、用户明细、会话数与输入不变；另测重复 login、孤立 logout、未关闭会话、同刻顺序、三种均值及总和超出 long 的情况。

复杂度与正确性

排序O(N log N)，扫描平均O(N)哈希操作，存储O(N+U)。BigInteger/BigDecimal额外位运算成本随累计位数增长，不能在任意精度模型下全视作机器常数。

边界、反例与追问

重复 login 覆盖最近时间、允许重叠会话或栈式配对都会改变答案；选择其他策略时必须修改状态机和测试，当前策略不是所有业务的统一规则。

完整Java实现与自测

示例代码（尚未验证运行结果）
import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;
public final class SessionDurations {
    public enum Operation { LOGIN, LOGOUT }
    public record Event(long timestampMillis,String user,Operation operation) {public Event{if(timestampMillis<0)throw new IllegalArgumentException("negative timestamp");Objects.requireNonNull(user);Objects.requireNonNull(operation);}}
    public record UserTotal(BigInteger millis,long sessions) {}
    public record Result(Map<String,UserTotal> users,BigInteger totalMillis,long sessions,long duplicateLogins,long orphanLogouts,int openAtEnd,Optional<BigDecimal> sessionMeanMillis,Optional<BigDecimal> meanOfUserSessionMeansMillis,Optional<BigDecimal> meanOfUserTotalMillis) {}
    private static final MathContext MC=MathContext.DECIMAL128;
    private static BigDecimal divide(BigInteger n,long d){return new BigDecimal(n).divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(d),MC);}
    // Stable timestamp sort; equal timestamps use input order. One active session per user.
    public static Result calculate(List<Event> events){Objects.requireNonNull(events);List<Event> sorted=new ArrayList<>(events);for(Event e:sorted)Objects.requireNonNull(e);sorted.sort(Comparator.comparingLong(Event::timestampMillis));Map<String,Long> active=new HashMap<>();Map<String,UserTotal> users=new HashMap<>();BigInteger total=BigInteger.ZERO;long count=0,duplicates=0,orphans=0;
        for(Event e:sorted){if(e.operation==Operation.LOGIN){if(active.putIfAbsent(e.user,e.timestampMillis)!=null)duplicates++;}else{Long start=active.remove(e.user);if(start==null){orphans++;continue;}long duration=e.timestampMillis-start;BigInteger d=BigInteger.valueOf(duration);UserTotal old=users.getOrDefault(e.user,new UserTotal(BigInteger.ZERO,0));users.put(e.user,new UserTotal(old.millis.add(d),old.sessions+1));total=total.add(d);count++;}}
        Optional<BigDecimal> session=Optional.empty(),means=Optional.empty(),totals=Optional.empty();if(count>0){session=Optional.of(divide(total,count));BigDecimal sumMeans=BigDecimal.ZERO;for(UserTotal u:users.values())sumMeans=sumMeans.add(divide(u.millis,u.sessions));means=Optional.of(sumMeans.divide(BigDecimal.valueOf(users.size()),MC));totals=Optional.of(divide(total,users.size()));}
        return new Result(Map.copyOf(users),total,count,duplicates,orphans,active.size(),session,means,totals);
    }
    static void check(boolean b){if(!b)throw new AssertionError();}
    public static void main(String[] args){List<Event> e=List.of(new Event(0,"a",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(10,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(20,"a",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(50,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(0,"b",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(100,"b",Operation.LOGOUT));Result x=calculate(e);check(x.sessions==3&&x.totalMillis.equals(BigInteger.valueOf(140))&&x.meanOfUserSessionMeansMillis.orElseThrow().compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(60))==0&&x.meanOfUserTotalMillis.orElseThrow().compareTo(BigDecimal.valueOf(70))==0);
        x=calculate(List.of(new Event(1,"a",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(2,"a",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(6,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(8,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(9,"b",Operation.LOGIN)));check(x.totalMillis.intValueExact()==5&&x.duplicateLogins==1&&x.orphanLogouts==1&&x.openAtEnd==1);
        check(calculate(List.of()).sessionMeanMillis.isEmpty());check(calculate(List.of(new Event(1,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(1,"a",Operation.LOGIN))).sessions==0);
        List<Event> huge=List.of(new Event(0,"a",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(Long.MAX_VALUE,"a",Operation.LOGOUT),new Event(0,"b",Operation.LOGIN),new Event(Long.MAX_VALUE,"b",Operation.LOGOUT));check(calculate(huge).totalMillis.equals(BigInteger.valueOf(Long.MAX_VALUE).multiply(BigInteger.TWO)));
        Random random=new Random(21);for(int t=0;t<1000;t++){List<Event> log=new ArrayList<>();Map<String,UserTotal> expected=new HashMap<>();long n=0;BigInteger sum=BigInteger.ZERO;for(int u=0;u<8;u++){long clock=u;String user="u"+u;int sessions=random.nextInt(10);BigInteger us=BigInteger.ZERO;for(int i=0;i<sessions;i++){long duration=1+random.nextInt(100);log.add(new Event(clock,user,Operation.LOGIN));log.add(new Event(clock+duration,user,Operation.LOGOUT));clock+=duration+10;us=us.add(BigInteger.valueOf(duration));}if(sessions>0)expected.put(user,new UserTotal(us,sessions));sum=sum.add(us);n+=sessions;}Collections.shuffle(log,random);List<Event> before=List.copyOf(log);x=calculate(log);check(x.sessions==n&&x.totalMillis.equals(sum)&&x.users.equals(expected)&&x.openAtEnd==0&&x.orphanLogouts==0&&x.duplicateLogins==0&&log.equals(before));}System.out.println("PASS 1000 shuffled-log oracle cases; three means/duplicates/orphans/open/ties/BigInteger/nonmutation");}
}

四TB整数日志精确Top10 外部分桶与有限值域计数

利用int32只有32位：按高8位分256桶流式写磁盘，同一个值一定进同一个桶；逐桶以低24位直接定位long计数数组。每桶最多2^24种不同值，long计数加touched下标数组共192MiB，远小于4G。每种值计数完成后更新全局大小10的最差项优先堆，最后按频次降序输出。

可能的问法

  • 4T 日志每行一个 int32，只有 4G 内存和普通 CPU，怎样精确统计出现次数最多的 10 个值？
  • 如何利用有限整数值域控制内存，怎样处理同频和整数极值？

输入、输出与前提

4T/4G的十进制或二进制单位、文本/二进制编码没有完全指定；不据此伪造记录数或完成时长。采用UTF-8每行一个有符号int32的输入，精确频次而非近似；同频按数值升序确定前10。需要足够额外磁盘保存分桶二进制数据，若禁止临时磁盘则换多遍扫描方案。

为什么这样做

直接对全部2^32取值建计数数组不可行：即使用4字节计数也需16GiB，8字节计数需32GiB，均超过4G；且4T输入中某值频次可能超过int上限，所以不能只为省空间用int计数。HashMap每条有对象/桶/装箱开销，不可用“一个int键加一个int值8字节”估内存。

分桶依unsigned右移value>>>24，包括负数在内的全部int位模式都有唯一高8位与低24位。相同值不可能跨桶，所以桶内计数已经是该值全局频次，无需再将同值跨桶累加。重构(bucket<<24)|low恢复原有符号int位模式，比较tie时用Integer比较而非unsigned顺序。

这比假设“哈希后每桶文件都小于内存”稳健：最坏4T全是同一个值，文件仍巨大但只有一个计数槽，读流逐条累加不会加载全文件。每桶不同键的上界由24位值域严格保证，数据偏斜只影响处理时长，不会使计数哈希表超过预算。

long[2^24]用128MiB，int[2^24]的touched列表用64MiB。首次命中某低位时登记，桶结束只遍历实际出现的低位并清0，避免每个小桶扫描所有槽。192MiB是两个原始数组有效载荷，真实进程还包括Java堆/对象头/输入缓冲/文件缓存等，应预留预算而不是把4G全分给数组。

每桶最多打开一个计数输入流；分桶写入用访问顺序缓存最多32个8KiB缓冲输出流，超限关闭旧流，之后APPEND重新打开，避免默认同时开256文件而超出文件描述符限制。随机高位分布下32个句柄可能频繁切换，IO效率需测量；可以在允许的句柄/内存预算内增加缓冲或两级分桶，不改变精确性。

Top10堆的根必须是当前最差候选：频次最低，同频时值更大。新候选更好才替换根。每个值只在其所属桶处理一次，堆大小最多10；最后排序10项。少于10种值就返回全部，不补虚构值。近似Count-Min/SpaceSaving只有明确允许误差时才可替代，当前题不允许直接丢精确性。

代码从文本逐行限64字符读取，拒绝空行、超长/非法/超int32值；分桶文件以writeInt四字节编码，读取时区分干净EOF与截断记录。频次用incrementExact，异常不静默回绕。临时目录由本次运行新建，finally删除自己创建的桶文件，输入不修改；IO失败会整体报错，不以部分堆结果宣称完成。

输入若原本二进制4T可约有10^12条量级，但文本含符号与换行就不同，必须按实测格式计N。总至少要读完整输入一遍，分桶法又写/读约4N字节临时数据；普通CPU可执行顺序解析和计数，瓶颈可能磁盘带宽/句柄抖动，不能承诺固定分钟数。

没有额外磁盘时，仍可用同一192MiB数组分256遍扫描原日志，每遍只统计一个高8位区间，内存有界但读取代价高256倍。外部归并排序是另一精确路线：有限块排序生成runs、多路分批归并，最终run-length计数；要限制归并fan-in而非一次打开所有runs。

例子与推演

自测可缩小 lowBits 配置，强制多桶处理，并用完整 HashMap 计数后排序作独立参考。覆盖正负 int 极值、同频、全同值、空文件、非法记录、输入保持和临时目录清理。真实大文件部署还需单独测量峰值内存、磁盘和吞吐。

复杂度与正确性

设 N 为记录数、U 为不同值数，流式读取、分桶和计数为 O(N)，堆为 O(U log 10)，另有至多 2^24 个计数项的初始化。有效桶与打开文件管理还含目录成本。lowBits=24 时两个数组约 192MiB，再加固定缓冲和 O(10) 堆；临时磁盘为 4N 字节加元数据。可用 lowBits=4、8、12 构造较小边界用例，但参数缩小不能替代目标机器的资源核算。

边界、反例与追问

需要先核对可用临时磁盘、进程实际RSS、允许打开文件数、日志编码与snapshot一致性；输入持续变化应固定快照/偏移边界，不能边读取边假定是完整静态4T。

import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;
import java.nio.file.*;
import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
public final class ExternalIntTop {
    public record Count(int value,long frequency) {}
    private static final Comparator<Count> BEST=Comparator.comparingLong(Count::frequency).reversed().thenComparingInt(Count::value);
    private static String readRecord(Reader in)throws IOException{StringBuilder line=new StringBuilder();int c;while((c=in.read())!=-1&&c!='\n'){if(line.length()==64)throw new IOException("record exceeds64 chars");line.append((char)c);}return c==-1&&line.isEmpty()?null:line.toString();}
    private static Integer readInt(DataInputStream in)throws IOException{int a=in.read();if(a<0)return null;return a<<24|in.readUnsignedByte()<<16|in.readUnsignedByte()<<8|in.readUnsignedByte();}
    private static final class Writers implements AutoCloseable {
        private final Path dir;private final LinkedHashMap<Integer,DataOutputStream> open=new LinkedHashMap<>(32,.75f,true);
        Writers(Path dir){this.dir=dir;}
        void append(int bucket,int value)throws IOException{DataOutputStream out=open.get(bucket);if(out==null){if(open.size()==32){var it=open.entrySet().iterator();var eldest=it.next();eldest.getValue().close();it.remove();}out=new DataOutputStream(new BufferedOutputStream(Files.newOutputStream(dir.resolve(bucket+".bin"),StandardOpenOption.CREATE,StandardOpenOption.APPEND),8192));open.put(bucket,out);}out.writeInt(value);}
        public void close()throws IOException{IOException failure=null;for(DataOutputStream out:open.values())try{out.close();}catch(IOException e){if(failure==null)failure=e;else if(failure!=e)failure.addSuppressed(e);}open.clear();if(failure!=null)throw failure;}
    }
    // Input UTF-8 text: exactly one signed decimal int32 per nonempty line.
    // Production lowBits=24 => 256 buckets and 192 MiB primitive counting arrays.
    public static List<Count> top(Path input,Path workDirectory,int k,int lowBits)throws IOException{
        if(k<0||lowBits<1||lowBits>24)throw new IllegalArgumentException();Objects.requireNonNull(input);Objects.requireNonNull(workDirectory);Path dir=Files.createTempDirectory(workDirectory,"int32-top-");
        try{try(Writers writers=new Writers(dir);BufferedReader in=Files.newBufferedReader(input,StandardCharsets.UTF_8)){String line;while((line=readRecord(in))!=null){if(line.isBlank())throw new IllegalArgumentException("blank record");int value=Integer.parseInt(line.trim());writers.append(value>>>lowBits,value);}}
            int slots=1<<lowBits,mask=slots-1;long[] counts=new long[slots];int[] touched=new int[slots];PriorityQueue<Count> heap=new PriorityQueue<>(Math.max(1,k),BEST.reversed());
            try(DirectoryStream<Path> files=Files.newDirectoryStream(dir,"*.bin")){for(Path bucketFile:files){int bucket=Integer.parseInt(bucketFile.getFileName().toString().replace(".bin","")),used=0;try(DataInputStream in=new DataInputStream(new BufferedInputStream(Files.newInputStream(bucketFile)))){Integer value;while((value=readInt(in))!=null){int index=value&mask;if(counts[index]==0)touched[used++]=index;counts[index]=Math.incrementExact(counts[index]);}}for(int t=0;t<used;t++){int low=touched[t];Count hit=new Count(bucket<<lowBits|low,counts[low]);if(k>0){if(heap.size()<k)heap.add(hit);else if(BEST.compare(hit,heap.peek())<0){heap.remove();heap.add(hit);}}counts[low]=0;}}}
            List<Count> result=new ArrayList<>(heap);result.sort(BEST);return result;
        }finally{try(DirectoryStream<Path> files=Files.newDirectoryStream(dir)){for(Path file:files)Files.delete(file);}Files.delete(dir);}
    }
    public static void main(String[] args)throws Exception{Path base=Files.createTempDirectory("external-top-test-");try{Path input=base.resolve("input.txt");Random random=new Random(840);for(int test=0;test<20;test++){Map<Integer,Long> expected=new HashMap<>();StringBuilder data=new StringBuilder();for(int i=0,n=1000+random.nextInt(2000);i<n;i++){int v=i%17==0?Integer.MIN_VALUE:i%19==0?Integer.MAX_VALUE:random.nextInt(501)-250;data.append(v).append('\n');expected.merge(v,1L,Long::sum);}Files.writeString(input,data,StandardCharsets.UTF_8);List<Count> oracle=new ArrayList<>();for(var e:expected.entrySet())oracle.add(new Count(e.getKey(),e.getValue()));oracle.sort(BEST);oracle=new ArrayList<>(oracle.subList(0,Math.min(10,oracle.size())));for(int bits:new int[]{4,8,12})if(!top(input,base,10,bits).equals(oracle))throw new AssertionError();}
            Files.writeString(input,"7\n".repeat(10000),StandardCharsets.UTF_8);if(!top(input,base,10,8).equals(List.of(new Count(7,10000))))throw new AssertionError();Files.writeString(input,"",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);if(!top(input,base,10,8).isEmpty())throw new AssertionError();Files.writeString(input,"1\n2147483648\n",StandardCharsets.UTF_8);try{top(input,base,10,8);throw new AssertionError();}catch(NumberFormatException ok){}try(var files=Files.list(base)){if(files.count()!=1)throw new AssertionError("temporary bucket cleanup");}Files.delete(input);System.out.println("PASS 60 real disk partition/count top10 comparisons; signed extremes/ties/all-identical/empty/invalid/cleanup; no 4TB run claimed");
        }finally{try(var files=Files.list(base)){for(Path file:files.toList())Files.delete(file);}Files.delete(base);}}
}

大文件重复行与频次TopK：有界外排序、全局聚合和数值TopK区别

Top100 如果按已有数值或分数排序，单遍维护大小为 100 的小顶堆就行；如果按频次排序，必须先汇总同一个键在所有文件里的完整次数，再进 TopK 堆。

文件大于内存时，先分批排序落盘成 run，再固定路数、多轮归并，在相邻同键处求和。最后顺序扫一遍：一边输出 count>1 的重复行，一边维护 Top100。堆解决的是“完整计数里的前一百”，并不替代前面的全局计数。

可能的问法

  • 极大量数据取 Top100，先要确认按数值还是按频次吗？
  • 10 个 100G 查询日志文件、单机仅 10G 内存且允许多机，怎样找出访问频次最高的 100 个 Query？
  • 文件超过内存时，怎样找出重复的完整行？

输入、输出与前提

按数值取最大、按完整 Query 累计频次、输出重复整行，是三个不同接口。这里按 UTF-8 每行一个 Query 或记录，去掉 LF 及其前可选 CR，不 trim、不折叠大小写、不做 Unicode 规范化，空行也是一个键。重复输出每个重复键与次数各一次；频次 TopK 按次数降序，同次数按 Java String 顺序升序。输入必须是冻结快照，程序不修改输入文件。

为什么这样做

数值TopK不变量：堆保存已读前缀中最大的至多K个元素，根是其中最小者；新值不超过根可丢，超过则替根。每个元素处理O(log K)，空间O(K)，最后把堆排序才是有序TopK输出，遍历PriorityQueue不是有序结果。完整largest接口保留重复数值出现次数；若要不同值TopK，需额外明确去重语义和状态。

频次 TopK 不能把每条输入记录原样放进 100 元素堆：暂时低频的 Query 以后可能大量出现。不同 Query 很多时，全量 HashMap 会超过 10GB；任意字符串键也不能直接套 int32 全集的定长计数。能装入内存时用 Map<整行,long> 计数，再筛 count>1 或维护 TopK；超过内存时改为外存聚合。

完整Java外排序先按chunkRecords条数分批，每条原始行在LF之前最多32768字节（若为CRLF，该CR也计入此读取配额），UTF-8严格解码；只在读到LF时移除其前至多一个CR，EOF前孤立CR或额外CR均属于键。每批排序，相同键压缩成(key,count)二进制记录。字段用长度前缀和long计数，避免Query内部tab、分隔符碰巧破坏中间格式；排序按完整String比较，哈希碰撞不参与等价判定。超长行拒绝是明确演示协议，真实无限长行需外部块比较/更复杂的流式键表示，不能一句“逐行读”假装有界。

归并每轮只打开fanIn个run，每个读器只留一个当前(key,count)，小顶堆按key排序取下一项，相邻同键累加并写下一轮run。run路径按(stage,index)生成，只保留总run数，不把海量文件路径全部加载内存。完成一组才删除本程序自己的上一轮文件；最终所有相同键必聚成一条完整全局计数。计数加法Math.addExact溢出就报错，不静默变负。

最后读完整计数流，count>1发给Consumer流式输出重复键及次数，同时用大小K堆保留最优计数。最差根按频次小优先、同频key更大优先，这与最终频次降序/key升序的总序相反，保证边界相同频率时可重复。若要重复行所在行号或全部副本，当前接口不提供，需额外保存偏移/第二遍扫描，不能只从count恢复位置。

10GB内存要留给JVM、GC、IO缓冲、索引对象和结果，chunkRecords×最大行宽决定上界量级，但对象头/字符串编码/排序引用数组和临时拷贝仍需真实测量。给定有限chunkRecords、fanIn和行长度，内存不随总输入规模无限增长；并不宣称本程序精准≤某固定MiB。磁盘峰值含输入、run、中间新一轮文件及输出，IO带宽、磁盘空间、文件句柄和失败清理都要预算。目标规模的性能需要按上述资源口径评估，不能由小文件测试直接外推。

多机可用稳定hash(Query)按键分区，Map阶段产生(Query,1)，可用局部combiner先合并计数减网络；同键的所有部分次数最后必须到同一逻辑归并者求和，得到完整(key,total)。然后各键分区输出自己的Top100，汇总这些候选再Top100是正确的：若某键连所在分区Top100都进不了，已有100个同分区完整键按一致总序胜过它，它不可能全局Top100。

但“每原始文件各算Top100再合并”一般错误，因为同键频次跨文件分散。构造10个文件，每文件共同Query x出现50次，另有100个仅该文件独有的Query各51次；x在每文件都进不了Top100，但全局x=500，所有私有键只有51，x是全局最高。必须先按完整Query聚合再裁剪候选，不能忽略数据分布前提。

分区偏斜不能只加桶数就保证内存：同一超级热键仍去同桶，但排序归并按键流式计数可只持一个累加器。若要拆热点，可先按额外盐分片做部分计数，再去盐按Query合并，最终完成后才TopK。稳定哈希仅路由，保留完整键验证相等，不能把64位hash相等直接视为相同Query。近似sketch/采样可能降低成本，但有误差，题目要求精确时不能暗换。

脚本是单机批任务：创建专用临时目录、结束时清理自有文件，不修改输入；它不提供断点恢复和作业提交协议。需要这些能力时，应增加 run 清单与校验和、输入快照版本、每轮完成标记、幂等重算和临时结果原子发布。输出 callback 失败时可能已产生部分结果，不能视为事务。多机部署还需框架的调度、容错与网络协议。

例子与推演

同一行出现三次输出一次(key,3)；不同大小写或不同Unicode编码序列默认不同。CRLF与LF行结束符不属于键，最后一行没有换行仍计入；文件末尾单独CR不是CRLF，必须保留为键内容，例如文件"x\n"与文件"x\r"是两个不同键。

外排序用很小的 chunk 与 fan-in 强制多段、多轮归并，再与完整 HashMap 频次、重复集合和 TopK 对照。覆盖 Unicode、空行空文件、CRLF、同频并列、输入不变、临时清理、非法 UTF-8 和超长行；数值 TopK 另测 long 极值与重复值。

复杂度与正确性

设N行、每批R行、初始run数S≈ceil(N/R)、归并路数F、键比较最坏成本B。初始排序O(N log R·B)，每轮归并O(N log F·B)，最多ceil(log_F S)轮，压缩重复可减少后续记录数；磁盘每轮顺序读写相应数据。最终U个不同键TopK O(U log(K+1)·比较成本)，输出排序O(K log K)。内存O(RB+FB+KB)加有界缓冲和实现对象开销，磁盘O(输入字节量级及中间层)，不是O(K)整体。

边界、反例与追问

十个各 100GB 日志、仅 10GB 内存并允许多机时，先明确按 Query 频次还是数值排名；下面保留精确全键聚合与全局 Top100，不能让多机成为省略全局统计的理由。

当前字符串比较是Java UTF16词典序，只用于同频稳定tie，不宣称按中文拼音/自然语言排序；统计相等以精确字符串为准。
