records.before:
同步 Callable 最多 100 个，最多 3 并发；成功等待全部并按完成顺序返回结果。失败或总执行预算超时会取消剩余任务并报告原始异常；若要求失败后仍执行全部任务，应改为收集每项成功/失败。取消不等于远端副作用停止。额外清理等待最多 2 秒，不是硬性总返回期限。

TaskProcessor.java · backend-scenarios L2675–2733
import java.util.*;
import java.util.concurrent.*;

/** Batch size <= 100. Three synchronous tasks maximum, including failures. */
public final class TaskProcessor {
    public static <T> List<T> run(List<? extends Callable<T>> tasks,
                                  long timeout, TimeUnit unit) throws Exception {
        Objects.requireNonNull(tasks); Objects.requireNonNull(unit);
        if (tasks.size() > 100 || timeout <= 0)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("at most 100 tasks and positive timeout");
        for (Callable<T> task : tasks) Objects.requireNonNull(task);
        ThreadPoolExecutor pool = new ThreadPoolExecutor(3, 3, 0, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS,
                new ArrayBlockingQueue<Runnable>(100), new ThreadPoolExecutor.AbortPolicy());
        CompletionService<T> completed = new ExecutorCompletionService<>(pool);
        List<Future<T>> futures = new ArrayList<>();
        List<T> results = new ArrayList<>();
        long budget = unit.toNanos(timeout), start = System.nanoTime();
        Throwable primary = null;
        try {
            for (Callable<T> task : tasks) futures.add(completed.submit(task));
            for (int i = 0; i < tasks.size(); i++) {
                long left = budget - (System.nanoTime() - start);
                if (left <= 0) throw new TimeoutException("batch deadline exceeded");
                Future<T> f = completed.poll(left, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
                if (f == null) throw new TimeoutException("batch deadline exceeded");
                results.add(f.get());     // Completion order; surface task failure immediately.
            }
            return results;
        } catch (Exception | Error ex) {
            primary = ex;
            throw ex;
        } finally {
            for (Future<?> f : futures) if (!f.isDone()) f.cancel(true);
            // Cancellation is a request, not proof the external operation stopped.
            stop(pool, 2, TimeUnit.SECONDS, primary);
        }
    }
    public static <T> T underPermit(Semaphore slots, Callable<T> operation) throws Exception {
        slots.acquire();                 // If this throws, no permit was acquired.
        try { return operation.call(); }
        finally { slots.release(); }     // Release only after a successful acquire.
    }
    private static void stop(ExecutorService pool, long wait, TimeUnit unit, Throwable primary)
            throws InterruptedException {
        pool.shutdownNow();
        try {
            if (!pool.awaitTermination(wait, unit)) {
                IllegalStateException cleanup = new IllegalStateException(
                        "workers remain alive after cancellation; inspect blocked operations");
                if (primary == null) throw cleanup;
                primary.addSuppressed(cleanup);
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException cleanup) {
            if (primary == null) throw cleanup;
            primary.addSuppressed(cleanup);
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); // Preserve a second interrupt during cleanup.
        }
    }
}
records.after:
同步调用可以先选固定 3 个工作线程，主线程按完成顺序收集 Future，并对每项取结果，才能发现任务异常。单纯等待一个计数器归零，不能证明全部任务成功。这里采用遇错取消剩余任务的合同；若要求失败后也继续跑完 100 项，就要保存每项成功或失败，不能把两种结束条件混在一起。

这是 Java 后端大厂高频。面试官想看你是否理解线程池不是“随便 newFixedThreadPool”，而是资源隔离、背压和故障保护。

Executors.newFixedThreadPool 默认使用无界队列，任务堆积时可能 OOM。newCachedThreadPool 最大线程数接近无限，可能创建过多线程。
records.after:
线程池把“正在执行”和“等待执行”的任务分开，两部分都占资源。参数要从计算与等待时间、下游容量、可接受排队时间推出来，不能只根据任务数量随意定线程数。

Executors.newFixedThreadPool 默认使用无界队列，任务堆积时可能 OOM。newCachedThreadPool 最大线程数接近无限，可能创建过多线程。

review.rationale: 从资源占用推参数。

records.before:
显式创建线程池：

Answer.java
import java.util.concurrent.ArrayBlockingQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadPoolExecutor;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicInteger;

public class Pools {
    public static ThreadPoolExecutor build() {
        AtomicInteger index = new AtomicInteger();
        return new ThreadPoolExecutor(
                8,
                16,
                60,
                TimeUnit.SECONDS,
                new ArrayBlockingQueue<>(1000),
                runnable -> {
                    Thread t = new Thread(runnable);
                    t.setName("index-worker-" + index.incrementAndGet());
                    return t;
                },
                new ThreadPoolExecutor.CallerRunsPolicy()
        );
    }
}

回答参数时要结合任务类型：

  • CPU 密集型：corePoolSize ≈ CPU 核数，避免上下文切换。

import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.PriorityQueue;
import java.util.concurrent.CompletableFuture;
import java.util.concurrent.RejectedExecutionException;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Java 21: bounded, one-shot, in-memory scheduler; callbacks run serially. */
public final class SimpleScheduler implements AutoCloseable {
    private record Task(long deadline, long order, Runnable action, CompletableFuture<Void> result) { }
    private final PriorityQueue<Task> queue = new PriorityQueue<>((a,b) -> {
        int c = Long.compare(a.deadline(), b.deadline());
        return c != 0 ? c : Long.compare(a.order(), b.order());
    });
    private final long origin = System.nanoTime();
    private final int capacity;
    private final Thread worker;
    private long order;
    private boolean closed;
    private Task running;
    public SimpleScheduler() { this(10_000); }
    public SimpleScheduler(int capacity) {
        if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 100_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
        this.capacity = capacity;
        worker = new Thread(this::loop, "simple-scheduler");
        worker.setDaemon(true);
        worker.start();
    }
    private long elapsed() {
        long value = System.nanoTime() - origin;
        if (value < 0) throw new IllegalStateException("lifetime exceeds nanoTime comparison range");
        return value;
    }
    public CompletableFuture<Void> schedule(Runnable action, long delayMillis) {
        Objects.requireNonNull(action);
        if (delayMillis < 0 || delayMillis > 86_400_000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("delay 0..one day");
        synchronized (queue) {
            if (closed || queue.size() == capacity) throw new RejectedExecutionException("closed/full");
            long deadline = Math.addExact(elapsed(), TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(delayMillis));
            long next = Math.incrementExact(order);
            CompletableFuture<Void> result = new CompletableFuture<>();
            queue.add(new Task(deadline, next, action, result));
            order = next;
            queue.notifyAll();
            return result;
        }
    }
    private void loop() {
        try {
            while (true) {
                Task task;
                synchronized (queue) {
                    while (!closed && queue.isEmpty()) queue.wait();
                    if (closed) return;
                    long remaining = queue.peek().deadline() - elapsed();
                    if (remaining > 0) { TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS.timedWait(queue, remaining); continue; }
                    task = queue.remove(); running = task;
                }
                try {
                    if (!task.result().isCancelled()) {
                        task.action().run();
                        task.result().complete(null);
                    }
                } catch (RuntimeException ex) { task.result().completeExceptionally(ex);
                } catch (Error fatal) { task.result().completeExceptionally(fatal); throw fatal;
                } finally { synchronized (queue) { running = null; } }
            }
        } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
            Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
        } finally {
            synchronized (queue) {
                closed = true;
                while (!queue.isEmpty()) queue.remove().result().cancel(false);
            }
        }
    }
    /** Discards waiting work, requests cooperative interruption, waits at most two seconds. */
    @Override public void close() throws InterruptedException {
        if (Thread.currentThread() == worker) throw new IllegalStateException("close from lifecycle thread");
        synchronized (queue) {
            closed = true;
            while (!queue.isEmpty()) queue.remove().result().cancel(false);
            if (running != null) running.result().cancel(false);
            queue.notifyAll();
        }
        worker.interrupt();
        worker.join(2_000);
        if (worker.isAlive()) throw new IllegalStateException("callback ignored interruption");
    }
}

-- Redis 7+; KEYS[1] = events ZSET, KEYS[2] = logical-clock STRING.
-- Both keys MUST share a Redis Cluster hash tag and belong only to this script.
-- ARGV = windowMs, maxCount, freshAttemptId. Window is (now-windowMs, now].
if #KEYS ~= 2 or #ARGV ~= 3 or KEYS[1] == KEYS[2] then
    return redis.error_reply('expected two distinct same-slot keys and three arguments')
end
local window = tonumber(ARGV[1])
local limit = tonumber(ARGV[2])
local member = ARGV[3]
if not window or window < 1 or window > 86400000 or window ~= math.floor(window)
    or not limit or limit < 1 or limit > 1000000 or limit ~= math.floor(limit)
    or not member or #member < 1 or #member > 128 then
    return redis.error_reply('invalid rate-limit arguments')
end
local t = redis.call('TIME')
local physical = tonumber(t[1]) * 1000 + math.floor(tonumber(t[2]) / 1000)
local rawLast = redis.call('GET', KEYS[2])
local last = tonumber(rawLast or '0')
if not last or last < 0 or last > 9007199254740991 or last ~= math.floor(last)
    or physical < 0 or physical > 9007199167339991 then
    return redis.error_reply('invalid clock')
end
-- Read/type validation precedes all writes. The key namespace is exclusive.
redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[1])
if last - physical > 86400000 then return redis.error_reply('clock rollback exceeds one day') end
local now = math.max(physical, last) -- Clamp local backward jumps; no cross-failover guarantee.
redis.call('ZREMRANGEBYSCORE', KEYS[1], '-inf', now - window)
local count = redis.call('ZCARD', KEYS[1])
local allowed = 0
if redis.call('ZSCORE', KEYS[1], member) then
    allowed = -1 -- Reused ID is rejected; never silently overwrite a previous attempt.
elseif count < limit then
    redis.call('ZADD', KEYS[1], 'NX', now, member)
    count = count + 1
    allowed = 1
end
-- Extend both lifetimes consistently, including a conservative clock-backward allowance.
local ttl = window + math.max(0, now - physical) + 1000
redis.call('SET', KEYS[2], string.format('%.0f', now), 'PX', ttl)
redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ttl)
local retry = 0
if allowed == 0 then
    local oldest = redis.call('ZRANGE', KEYS[1], 0, 0, 'WITHSCORES')
    retry = math.max(1, tonumber(oldest[2]) + window - now)
end

import java.util.Arrays;

import java.util.Objects;

import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.DefaultRedisScript;
import org.springframework.scripting.support.ResourceScriptSource;

/** Integration example: requires a configured StringRedisTemplate and limit.lua on classpath. */
public final class RedisSlidingWindow {
    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;
    private final DefaultRedisScript<List> script;
    public RedisSlidingWindow(StringRedisTemplate redis) {
        this.redis = Objects.requireNonNull(redis);
        script = new DefaultRedisScript<>();
        script.setResultType(List.class);
        script.setScriptSource(new ResourceScriptSource(new ClassPathResource("limit.lua")));
    }
    public static final class Decision {
        public final boolean allowed;
        public final long remaining, retryAfterMs;
        private Decision(boolean allowed, long remaining, long retryAfterMs) {
            this.allowed = allowed; this.remaining = remaining; this.retryAfterMs = retryAfterMs;
        }
    }
    public Decision acquire(String bucket, int maxCount, long windowMs) {
        if (bucket == null || !bucket.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,120}"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("use a stable, nonsecret bucket identifier");
        if (maxCount <= 0 || maxCount > 1000000 || windowMs <= 0 || windowMs > 86400000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported rate-limit policy");
        // The same {...} hashes both keys to one Redis Cluster slot.
        // Include policy parameters to avoid mixing incompatible windows in one log.
        String base = "rl:{" + bucket + "}:w" + windowMs + ":n" + maxCount;
        List<?> result = redis.execute(script,
                Arrays.asList(base + ":events", base + ":clock"),
                Long.toString(windowMs), Integer.toString(maxCount), UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        if (result == null || result.size() != 3) throw new IllegalStateException("invalid Redis reply");
        long code = ((Number) result.get(0)).longValue();
        if (code == -1) throw new IllegalStateException("attempt ID reused");
        if (code != 0 && code != 1) throw new IllegalStateException("unknown decision code");
        return new Decision(code == 1, ((Number) result.get(1)).longValue(),
                ((Number) result.get(2)).longValue());
    }
}

redis.call('SET', KEYS[2], string.format('%.0f', now), 'PX', ttl)
redis.call('PEXPIRE', KEYS[1], ttl)
local retry = 0
if allowed == 0 then
    local oldest = redis.call('ZRANGE', KEYS[1], 0, 0, 'WITHSCORES')
    retry = math.max(1, tonumber(oldest[2]) + window - now)
end
return {allowed, math.max(0, limit - count), retry}

import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.UUID;
import org.springframework.core.io.ClassPathResource;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.StringRedisTemplate;
import org.springframework.data.redis.core.script.DefaultRedisScript;
import org.springframework.scripting.support.ResourceScriptSource;

/** Integration example: requires a configured StringRedisTemplate and limit.lua on classpath. */
public final class RedisSlidingWindow {
    private final StringRedisTemplate redis;
    private final DefaultRedisScript<List> script;
    public RedisSlidingWindow(StringRedisTemplate redis) {
        this.redis = Objects.requireNonNull(redis);
        script = new DefaultRedisScript<>();
        script.setResultType(List.class);
        script.setScriptSource(new ResourceScriptSource(new ClassPathResource("limit.lua")));
    }
    public static final class Decision {
        public final boolean allowed;
        public final long remaining, retryAfterMs;
        private Decision(boolean allowed, long remaining, long retryAfterMs) {
            this.allowed = allowed; this.remaining = remaining; this.retryAfterMs = retryAfterMs;
        }
    }
    public Decision acquire(String bucket, int maxCount, long windowMs) {
        if (bucket == null || !bucket.matches("[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]{1,120}"))
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("use a stable, nonsecret bucket identifier");
        if (maxCount <= 0 || maxCount > 1000000 || windowMs <= 0 || windowMs > 86400000)
            throw new IllegalArgumentException("unsupported rate-limit policy");
        // The same {...} hashes both keys to one Redis Cluster slot.
        // Include policy parameters to avoid mixing incompatible windows in one log.
        String base = "rl:{" + bucket + "}:w" + windowMs + ":n" + maxCount;
        List<?> result = redis.execute(script,
                Arrays.asList(base + ":events", base + ":clock"),
                Long.toString(windowMs), Integer.toString(maxCount), UUID.randomUUID().toString());
        if (result == null || result.size() != 3) throw new IllegalStateException("invalid Redis reply");
        long code = ((Number) result.get(0)).longValue();
        if (code == -1) throw new IllegalStateException("attempt ID reused");
        if (code != 0 && code != 1) throw new IllegalStateException("unknown decision code");
        return new Decision(code == 1, ((Number) result.get(1)).longValue(),
                ((Number) result.get(2)).longValue());
    }
}

entryIdentity.title: 缓存一致性与热点缓存

records.before:
这题是 Java 后端高频。面试官一般想听到 Cache Aside、删除缓存而不是更新缓存、延迟双删/订阅 binlog、互斥锁重建、布隆过滤器、随机过期时间。

先明确一致性级别：缓存和数据库很难做到强一致，常见方案是最终一致。写操作以数据库为准，缓存是派生数据。
records.after:
我会先区分可接受短暂旧值的展示数据和必须以数据库裁决的业务判断。读多写少时采用 Cache Aside：缓存是数据库的派生结果，未命中才查库，写库后失效缓存。它减少常态查库，但数据库提交与缓存失效之间仍有窗口，不能把它当成强一致事务。

接着按流量为什么回源来处理：不存在的数据用空值缓存或布隆预筛；热点过期用合并重建或允许旧值的异步刷新；大量过期和 Redis 故障还要限制回源，避免数据库被一起压满。

review.rationale: 直接建立一致性与三种回源原因，不背组件目录。

entryIdentity.title: 缓存一致性与热点缓存

读流程：

  1. 查 Redis。
  2. 命中直接返回。
  3. 未命中先查布隆过滤器或空值缓存，判断是否可能存在。
  4. 查 MySQL。
  5. 存在则写 Redis，并设置随机 TTL；不存在则缓存短 TTL 空值。

写流程：

  1. 更新 MySQL。
  2. 删除 Redis 缓存。
  3. 如果业务对一致性要求较高，可以延迟再删一次，或监听 binlog 异步删缓存。

热点 Key 防击穿：每次获取锁生成唯一 token，SET NX PX 原子加锁；释放时在 Redis 内原子比较 owner 后删除。下面是 Java 17+ 教学实现，RedisPort / ProductStore / Pause 是基础设施抽象，并非某个 Redis SDK 或完整生产方案。

Answer.java
import java.util.UUID;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

// 教学基础设施接口：必须由真实 Redis / SQL 适配器实现下述原子语义。
final class CacheExample {
    record Product(long id) {}
    // null CacheEntry 表示未缓存；CacheEntry(null) 表示已缓存的“不存在”。
    record CacheEntry(Product value) {}
    interface RedisPort {
        CacheEntry get(String key);
        boolean setNxPx(String key, String token, long leaseMillis);
        // 在 Redis 内一次 Lua 执行 GET==token 时 DEL；禁止客户端 GET 后另发 DEL。
        boolean compareAndDelete(String key, String token);
        void put(String key, CacheEntry value, long ttlMillis);
    }
    interface ProductStore { Product find(long id); }
    interface Pause { void sleep(long millis) throws InterruptedException; }
    private final RedisPort redis;
    private final ProductStore store;
    private final Pause pause;
    CacheExample(RedisPort redis, ProductStore store, Pause pause) {
        this.redis = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(redis);
        this.store = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(store);
        this.pause = java.util.Objects.requireNonNull(pause);
    }
    Product getProduct(long id) throws InterruptedException {
        String key = "product:" + id;
        String lockKey = "lock:" + key;
        // 最多 3 次尝试；生产适配器还必须给 Redis/SQL 调用设置超时。
        for (int attempt = 0; attempt < 3; attempt++) {
            CacheEntry hit = redis.get(key);
            if (hit != null) return hit.value();
            String token = UUID.randomUUID().toString();
            if (redis.setNxPx(lockKey, token, 3_000)) {
                Throwable primary = null;
                try {
                    CacheEntry again = redis.get(key);
                    if (again != null) return again.value();
                    Product value = store.find(id);
                    long ttl = value == null ? 5_000 :
                        60_000 + ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong(10_000);
                    redis.put(key, new CacheEntry(value), ttl);
                    return value;
                } catch (RuntimeException | Error ex) {
                    primary = ex; throw ex;
                } finally {
                    try { redis.compareAndDelete(lockKey, token); }
                    catch (RuntimeException | Error cleanup) {
                        if (primary == null) throw cleanup;
                        if (primary != cleanup) primary.addSuppressed(cleanup);
                    }
                }
            }
            if (attempt < 2) pause.sleep(20);
        }
        CacheEntry last = redis.get(key);
        if (last != null) return last.value();
        // 等待未得到结果不能当作商品不存在，也不让所有请求绕过锁回源。
        throw new IllegalStateException("缓存重建繁忙，请稍后重试");
    }
}

变体 1：为什么写后删除缓存，而不是更新缓存？

分析：缓存可能是复杂聚合结果，更新成本高且容易漏字段。答案：删除缓存让下一次读按数据库重建，逻辑简单，最终一致性更好控制。

变体 2：先删缓存再写库有什么问题？

分析：删完缓存后，另一个读请求可能查旧库并回填旧缓存，然后写库提交，缓存长期是旧值。答案：通常写库后删缓存，必要时延迟双删。

变体 3：Redis 故障怎么办？

分析：缓存故障可能把流量打到数据库。答案：限流、降级、本地缓存兜底、熔断保护数据库，并监控 Redis 命中率和延迟。

/** One process/worker lifetime only; restarting requires persisted high-water coordination. */
public final class Snowflake {
    public static final long EPOCH = 1704067200000L;
    private static final long MAX_TIME = (1L << 41) - 1;
    private static final long MAX_SEQ = (1L << 12) - 1;
    private final long workerId;
    private final LongSupplier clock;
    private long lastMillis = -1, sequence;
    public Snowflake(long workerId) { this(workerId, System::currentTimeMillis); }
    public Snowflake(long workerId, LongSupplier clock) {
        if (workerId < 0 || workerId >= 1024) throw new IllegalArgumentException("workerId 0..1023");
        this.workerId = workerId; this.clock = Objects.requireNonNull(clock);
    }
    public synchronized long nextId() {
        long now = clock.getAsLong();
        if (now < EPOCH || now > EPOCH + MAX_TIME) throw new IllegalStateException("41-bit epoch exhausted/out of range");
        if (now < lastMillis) throw new IllegalStateException("clock moved backwards");
        long next = now == lastMillis ? sequence + 1 : 0;
        if (next > MAX_SEQ) throw new IllegalStateException("millisecond exhausted; retry after clock advances");
        long id = ((now - EPOCH) << 22) | (workerId << 12) | next;
        lastMillis = now; sequence = next;
        return id;
    }
}

以下状态机用于拆解责任；消费去重记录、业务效果和成功记录必须同事务提交，确认只在本地完成或恢复责任持久转交后发生。状态机示意：

responsibility-state.txt
业务责任示意（不是 Java 程序，也不是 broker 的原子状态机）：
INIT -> SAVED -> PUBLISHED -> CONSUMING -> SUCCESS
CONSUMING -> RETRYING -> DEAD
CONSUMING -> FAILED_COMPENSATABLE
COMMIT_UNKNOWN -> 同身份核对已提交回执；确认前不 ACK
SUCCESS / 已提交恢复任务 -> 尝试 ACK；ACK_UNKNOWN 不撤销已提交效果

核心设计：

  1. 接入事件时生成全局 eventId，业务表和 event_task 表在同一个 MySQL 事务内落库。
  2. 后台发布器扫描 SAVED 状态事件，发送 MQ。
  3. 开启 Publisher Confirm，确认还须合并 Return 与预期拓扑的路由结果，满足发送责任合同后才把状态改为 PUBLISHED；失败则保留待重试。
  4. 消费者以受信 (tenant, consumer, event) 为身份，在同一权威事务内检查不可变 payload、写 inbox、本地效果或发送任务责任及完成回执；重复身份必须核对已提交结果，不能只凭插入失败判断成功。
  5. 业务效果、去重与成功记录同事务提交后才手动 ACK；持久任务状态为 SUCCESS。
  6. 处理失败时按错误类型决定重试或死信；超过最大次数进入 DEAD，等待人工或补偿任务处理。重试/隔离责任未确认落库时不 ACK；仅告警日志或一次 NACK 不证明可靠转交。
  7. XXL-Job 可扫描 SAVED/PUBLISHED/RETRYING/CONSUMING 超时责任；按权威状态与稳定身份恢复。UNKNOWN 先核对，不能仅因超时就换身份重投或宣告失败。

可运行的有界事务教学模型：完整代码和 main 故障测试如下。Java 21 标准库，无第三方依赖；字段长度 1..256 UTF-16 单元，容量 1..256，满额拒绝且上游继续持有。MemoryTransactions 只模拟原子提交与存活存储的快照恢复，真实进程丢失会丢内存，不能当作 MySQL/RabbitMQ 持久化。LOCAL_EFFECT 只改本地计数；通知用稳定身份的责任任务，绝不把远程发送伪装成本地事务。只有确认提交才 ACK；COMMIT_UNKNOWN 保留原身份核对，ACK_UNKNOWN 不撤销或重复已提交业务。真实适配器仍须测试数据库错误码、隔离、唯一键/排序规则、提交恢复与 broker 拓扑。

事务记录的类型约束（设计表，不是已测试的 MySQL DDL）：

字段类型与约束
idBIGINT 自增代理主键，可用于审计；不是幂等身份。
tenant_id / consumer / event_id受信且不可变的字符串元组；权威唯一身份必须含租户。
payload_identity规范化 payload 字节或无歧义等价值；重复键必须比对，冲突不能当成功。
status / result / responsibility状态、原始完成结果，或稳定发送身份的重试/隔离责任；与 inbox、本地效果同事务提交。
created_at / updated_at非空审计时间；真实 INSERT/UPDATE 必须供给时间或明确数据库默认值。

下方 Java 使用结构化 Key、不可变 Receipt 和同一 State 来实现该核心事务契约；没有 JDBC、SQL 迁移或真实渠道。旧 DDL 的代理主键、状态和时间语义保留在上表，不能仅凭唯一键或表存在就声称事务可靠。

import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Java 21, no dependencies. Bounded transaction CONTRACT MODEL, not a database adapter. */
public final class InboxModel {
    private InboxModel() { }
    enum Plan { LOCAL_EFFECT, RETRY_TASK, QUARANTINE_TASK }
    enum Fault { NONE, AFTER_INBOX, EFFECT, OUTAGE, PERMISSION, OTHER_UNIQUE, HANDOFF, LOST_COMMIT_REPLY }
    enum Outcome { ACKED, COMMIT_UNKNOWN, NOT_COMMITTED, CONFLICT, ACK_UNKNOWN }
    record Key(String tenant, String consumer, String event) {
        Key { token(tenant); token(consumer); token(event); }
    }
    record Message(Key key, String canonicalPayload) {
        Message { Objects.requireNonNull(key); token(canonicalPayload); }
    }
    record Receipt(String payload, Plan plan, String result, Key externalRequestIdentity) { }
    record State(Map<Key, Receipt> inbox, Map<Key, Integer> effects, Map<Key, Receipt> tasks) {
        State { inbox = Map.copyOf(inbox); effects = Map.copyOf(effects); tasks = Map.copyOf(tasks); }
    }
    static final class StoreFailure extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        StoreFailure(String message) { super(message); }
    }
    static final class CommitUnknown extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    static final class PayloadConflict extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    interface Transactions {
        // Returned receipt MUST mean confirmed atomic commit. UNKNOWN must never be guessed as success.
        Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan) throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict;
    }
    interface Acknowledger { void ack() throws Exception; }

    /** Serializes commits. Immutable snapshots simulate an independently surviving store across worker restart.
     * JVM/process loss loses this store. No MySQL, broker, network send or disk durability is implemented.
     */
    static final class MemoryTransactions implements Transactions {
        private final int capacity;
        private State committed;
        private Fault nextFault = Fault.NONE;
        private CountDownLatch entered;
        private CountDownLatch release;
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity) { this(capacity, new State(Map.of(), Map.of(), Map.of())); }
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity, State image) {
            if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 256 || image.inbox().size() > capacity) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.committed = image;
        }
        synchronized void inject(Fault fault) { nextFault = fault; }
        synchronized void gate(CountDownLatch inside, CountDownLatch resume) { entered = inside; release = resume; }
        synchronized State image() { return committed; }
        @Override public synchronized Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan)
                throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict {
            Objects.requireNonNull(plan);
            Fault fault = nextFault;
            nextFault = Fault.NONE;
            if (fault == Fault.OUTAGE || fault == Fault.PERMISSION || fault == Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE)
                throw new StoreFailure(fault.name()); // Never classify arbitrary errors as duplicate delivery.
            Receipt prior = committed.inbox().get(message.key());
            if (prior != null) {
                if (!prior.payload().equals(message.canonicalPayload())) throw new PayloadConflict();
                return prior; // Recovery reads confirmed committed result, not just existence of a key.
            }
            if (committed.inbox().size() == capacity) throw new StoreFailure("capacity; retain broker ownership");
            if (entered != null) {
                entered.countDown();
                try {
                    if (!release.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new StoreFailure("test gate timeout");
                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw new StoreFailure("interrupted before commit");
                } finally { entered = null; release = null; }
            }
            Map<Key, Receipt> inbox = new HashMap<>(committed.inbox());
            Map<Key, Integer> effects = new HashMap<>(committed.effects());
            Map<Key, Receipt> tasks = new HashMap<>(committed.tasks());
            Receipt receipt = new Receipt(message.canonicalPayload(), plan,
                    plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT ? "local-accounting-applied" : "responsibility-stored", message.key());
            inbox.put(message.key(), receipt); // Private transaction workspace, invisible before commit.
            if (fault == Fault.AFTER_INBOX) throw new StoreFailure("rollback after inbox insert");
            if (plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT) {
                if (fault == Fault.EFFECT) throw new StoreFailure("effect rolled back");
                effects.merge(message.key(), 1, Math::addExact); // Pure local mutation, NEVER a remote notification.
            } else {
                if (fault == Fault.HANDOFF) throw new StoreFailure("task persistence failed");
                tasks.put(message.key(), receipt); // Outbox task and stable external request key committed together.
            }
            committed = new State(inbox, effects, tasks); // Single linearization point.
            if (fault == Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY) throw new CommitUnknown();
            return receipt;
        }
    }
    static Outcome consume(Transactions database, Message message, Plan plan, Acknowledger broker) {
        try {
            database.apply(message, plan);
        } catch (CommitUnknown ex) { return Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN;
        } catch (PayloadConflict ex) { return Outcome.CONFLICT;
        } catch (StoreFailure ex) { return Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED; }
        // Separate boundary: ACK failure cannot roll back, quarantine or repeat a committed local effect.
        try { broker.ack(); return Outcome.ACKED; }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }
    static void token(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.length() > 256) throw new IllegalArgumentException("1..256 UTF-16 units");
    }
    static Message msg(String tenant, String consumer, String event, String payload) {
        return new Message(new Key(tenant, consumer, event), payload);
    }
    static void check(boolean condition, String test) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(test); }
    static void passed(String name) { System.out.println("PASS " + name); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Message message = msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1");
        MemoryTransactions database = new MemoryTransactions(32);
        CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1), resume = new CountDownLatch(1), duplicateStarted = new CountDownLatch(1);
        database.gate(entered, resume);
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try {
            Future<Outcome> first = executor.submit(() -> consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }));
            check(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "first entered transaction");
            Future<Outcome> duplicate = executor.submit(() -> {
                duplicateStarted.countDown(); return consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
            });
            check(duplicateStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "duplicate started");
            check(!duplicate.isDone(), "duplicate before settle cannot acknowledge");
            resume.countDown();
            check(first.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED && duplicate.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED, "both settled");
            check(database.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "one effect");
            passed("concurrent identity; duplicate blocks until first transaction settles");
        } finally { resume.countDown(); executor.shutdownNow(); check(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "executor stopped"); }
        check(consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "changed"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.CONFLICT, "payload conflict");
        passed("same identity different payload conflicts");
        for (Fault fault : new Fault[]{Fault.AFTER_INBOX, Fault.EFFECT, Fault.OUTAGE, Fault.PERMISSION, Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE}) {
            MemoryTransactions failed = new MemoryTransactions(2); failed.inject(fault);
            check(consume(failed, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, fault.name());
            check(failed.image().inbox().isEmpty() && failed.image().effects().isEmpty(), "rollback " + fault);
            passed("no ACK/no committed inbox on " + fault);
        }
        MemoryTransactions uncertain = new MemoryTransactions(2); uncertain.inject(Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY);
        check(consume(uncertain, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK unknown"); }) == Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN, "unknown");
        MemoryTransactions restarted = new MemoryTransactions(2, uncertain.image());
        check(consume(restarted, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "recover");
        check(restarted.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "recovery no effect replay");
        passed("lost commit reply UNKNOWN; simulated restart recovers same committed receipt");
        for (Plan plan : new Plan[]{Plan.RETRY_TASK, Plan.QUARANTINE_TASK}) {
            MemoryTransactions handoff = new MemoryTransactions(2); handoff.inject(Fault.HANDOFF);
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK failed handoff"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "handoff failure");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().isEmpty(), "failed handoff retained upstream");
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "handoff confirmed");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().get(message.key()).externalRequestIdentity().equals(message.key()), "stable request identity");
            passed(plan + " failure retains upstream responsibility; success commits task");
        }
        MemoryTransactions ackFailure = new MemoryTransactions(2);
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new Exception("transport"); }) == Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN, "ack error");
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED && ackFailure.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "ack redelivery");
        passed("ACK transport failure never repeats committed effect");
        consume(database, msg("tenant-b", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "audit", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(database.image().effects().size() == 3, "namespace independence"); passed("tenants and consumers independent");
        MemoryTransactions full = new MemoryTransactions(1);
        consume(full, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(consume(full, msg("t", "c", "e", "p"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("capacity ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "capacity");
        passed("bounded capacity rejects without ACK or eviction");
    }
}

运行：保存为 InboxModel.java；使用 JDK 21 执行 javac -Xlint:all -Werror InboxModel.java，再执行 java InboxModel。测试断言覆盖并发重复、payload 冲突、插入后回滚、效果失败、数据库错误、提交响应丢失、重试/隔离失败、ACK 失败、租户/消费者隔离和容量。核心不变量：一次不可变 State 发布同时带上 inbox、效果/责任与原始结果；ACK 使用独立异常边界。

  6. 处理失败时按错误类型决定重试或死信；超过最大次数进入 DEAD，等待人工或补偿任务处理。重试/隔离责任未确认落库时不 ACK；仅告警日志或一次 NACK 不证明可靠转交。
  7. XXL-Job 可扫描 SAVED/PUBLISHED/RETRYING/CONSUMING 超时责任；按权威状态与稳定身份恢复。UNKNOWN 先核对，不能仅因超时就换身份重投或宣告失败。

可运行的有界事务教学模型：完整代码和 main 故障测试如下。Java 21 标准库，无第三方依赖；字段长度 1..256 UTF-16 单元，容量 1..256，满额拒绝且上游继续持有。MemoryTransactions 只模拟原子提交与存活存储的快照恢复，真实进程丢失会丢内存，不能当作 MySQL/RabbitMQ 持久化。LOCAL_EFFECT 只改本地计数；通知用稳定身份的责任任务，绝不把远程发送伪装成本地事务。只有确认提交才 ACK；COMMIT_UNKNOWN 保留原身份核对，ACK_UNKNOWN 不撤销或重复已提交业务。真实适配器仍须测试数据库错误码、隔离、唯一键/排序规则、提交恢复与 broker 拓扑。

事务记录的类型约束（设计表，不是已测试的 MySQL DDL）：

字段类型与约束
idBIGINT 自增代理主键，可用于审计；不是幂等身份。
tenant_id / consumer / event_id受信且不可变的字符串元组；权威唯一身份必须含租户。
payload_identity规范化 payload 字节或无歧义等价值；重复键必须比对，冲突不能当成功。
status / result / responsibility状态、原始完成结果，或稳定发送身份的重试/隔离责任；与 inbox、本地效果同事务提交。
created_at / updated_at非空审计时间；真实 INSERT/UPDATE 必须供给时间或明确数据库默认值。

下方 Java 使用结构化 Key、不可变 Receipt 和同一 State 来实现该核心事务契约；没有 JDBC、SQL 迁移或真实渠道。旧 DDL 的代理主键、状态和时间语义保留在上表，不能仅凭唯一键或表存在就声称事务可靠。

InboxModel.java
import java.util.HashMap;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
import java.util.concurrent.Future;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;

/** Java 21, no dependencies. Bounded transaction CONTRACT MODEL, not a database adapter. */
public final class InboxModel {
    private InboxModel() { }
    enum Plan { LOCAL_EFFECT, RETRY_TASK, QUARANTINE_TASK }
    enum Fault { NONE, AFTER_INBOX, EFFECT, OUTAGE, PERMISSION, OTHER_UNIQUE, HANDOFF, LOST_COMMIT_REPLY }
    enum Outcome { ACKED, COMMIT_UNKNOWN, NOT_COMMITTED, CONFLICT, ACK_UNKNOWN }
    record Key(String tenant, String consumer, String event) {
        Key { token(tenant); token(consumer); token(event); }
    }
    record Message(Key key, String canonicalPayload) {
        Message { Objects.requireNonNull(key); token(canonicalPayload); }
    }
    record Receipt(String payload, Plan plan, String result, Key externalRequestIdentity) { }
    record State(Map<Key, Receipt> inbox, Map<Key, Integer> effects, Map<Key, Receipt> tasks) {
        State { inbox = Map.copyOf(inbox); effects = Map.copyOf(effects); tasks = Map.copyOf(tasks); }
    }
    static final class StoreFailure extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
        StoreFailure(String message) { super(message); }
    }
    static final class CommitUnknown extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    static final class PayloadConflict extends Exception {
        private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
    }
    interface Transactions {
        // Returned receipt MUST mean confirmed atomic commit. UNKNOWN must never be guessed as success.
        Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan) throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict;
    }
    interface Acknowledger { void ack() throws Exception; }

    /** Serializes commits. Immutable snapshots simulate an independently surviving store across worker restart.
     * JVM/process loss loses this store. No MySQL, broker, network send or disk durability is implemented.
     */
    static final class MemoryTransactions implements Transactions {
        private final int capacity;
        private State committed;
        private Fault nextFault = Fault.NONE;
        private CountDownLatch entered;
        private CountDownLatch release;
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity) { this(capacity, new State(Map.of(), Map.of(), Map.of())); }
        MemoryTransactions(int capacity, State image) {
            if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 256 || image.inbox().size() > capacity) throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.committed = image;
        }
        synchronized void inject(Fault fault) { nextFault = fault; }
        synchronized void gate(CountDownLatch inside, CountDownLatch resume) { entered = inside; release = resume; }
        synchronized State image() { return committed; }
        @Override public synchronized Receipt apply(Message message, Plan plan)
                throws StoreFailure, CommitUnknown, PayloadConflict {
            Objects.requireNonNull(plan);
            Fault fault = nextFault;
            nextFault = Fault.NONE;
            if (fault == Fault.OUTAGE || fault == Fault.PERMISSION || fault == Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE)
                throw new StoreFailure(fault.name()); // Never classify arbitrary errors as duplicate delivery.
            Receipt prior = committed.inbox().get(message.key());
            if (prior != null) {
                if (!prior.payload().equals(message.canonicalPayload())) throw new PayloadConflict();
                return prior; // Recovery reads confirmed committed result, not just existence of a key.
            }
            if (committed.inbox().size() == capacity) throw new StoreFailure("capacity; retain broker ownership");
            if (entered != null) {
                entered.countDown();
                try {
                    if (!release.await(3, TimeUnit.SECONDS)) throw new StoreFailure("test gate timeout");
                } catch (InterruptedException ex) {
                    Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    throw new StoreFailure("interrupted before commit");
                } finally { entered = null; release = null; }
            }
            Map<Key, Receipt> inbox = new HashMap<>(committed.inbox());
            Map<Key, Integer> effects = new HashMap<>(committed.effects());
            Map<Key, Receipt> tasks = new HashMap<>(committed.tasks());
            Receipt receipt = new Receipt(message.canonicalPayload(), plan,
                    plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT ? "local-accounting-applied" : "responsibility-stored", message.key());
            inbox.put(message.key(), receipt); // Private transaction workspace, invisible before commit.
            if (fault == Fault.AFTER_INBOX) throw new StoreFailure("rollback after inbox insert");
            if (plan == Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT) {
                if (fault == Fault.EFFECT) throw new StoreFailure("effect rolled back");
                effects.merge(message.key(), 1, Math::addExact); // Pure local mutation, NEVER a remote notification.
            } else {
                if (fault == Fault.HANDOFF) throw new StoreFailure("task persistence failed");
                tasks.put(message.key(), receipt); // Outbox task and stable external request key committed together.
            }
            committed = new State(inbox, effects, tasks); // Single linearization point.
            if (fault == Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY) throw new CommitUnknown();
            return receipt;
        }
    }
    static Outcome consume(Transactions database, Message message, Plan plan, Acknowledger broker) {
        try {
            database.apply(message, plan);
        } catch (CommitUnknown ex) { return Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN;
        } catch (PayloadConflict ex) { return Outcome.CONFLICT;
        } catch (StoreFailure ex) { return Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED; }
        // Separate boundary: ACK failure cannot roll back, quarantine or repeat a committed local effect.
        try { broker.ack(); return Outcome.ACKED; }
        catch (Exception ex) {
            if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
            return Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN;
        }
    }
    static void token(String value) {
        if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.length() > 256) throw new IllegalArgumentException("1..256 UTF-16 units");
    }
    static Message msg(String tenant, String consumer, String event, String payload) {
        return new Message(new Key(tenant, consumer, event), payload);
    }
    static void check(boolean condition, String test) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(test); }
    static void passed(String name) { System.out.println("PASS " + name); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Message message = msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1");
        MemoryTransactions database = new MemoryTransactions(32);
        CountDownLatch entered = new CountDownLatch(1), resume = new CountDownLatch(1), duplicateStarted = new CountDownLatch(1);
        database.gate(entered, resume);
        ExecutorService executor = Executors.newFixedThreadPool(2);
        try {
            Future<Outcome> first = executor.submit(() -> consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }));
            check(entered.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "first entered transaction");
            Future<Outcome> duplicate = executor.submit(() -> {
                duplicateStarted.countDown(); return consume(database, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
            });
            check(duplicateStarted.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "duplicate started");
            check(!duplicate.isDone(), "duplicate before settle cannot acknowledge");
            resume.countDown();
            check(first.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED && duplicate.get(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS) == Outcome.ACKED, "both settled");
            check(database.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "one effect");
            passed("concurrent identity; duplicate blocks until first transaction settles");
        } finally { resume.countDown(); executor.shutdownNow(); check(executor.awaitTermination(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "executor stopped"); }
        check(consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "notifications", "event-1", "changed"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.CONFLICT, "payload conflict");
        passed("same identity different payload conflicts");
        for (Fault fault : new Fault[]{Fault.AFTER_INBOX, Fault.EFFECT, Fault.OUTAGE, Fault.PERMISSION, Fault.OTHER_UNIQUE}) {
            MemoryTransactions failed = new MemoryTransactions(2); failed.inject(fault);
            check(consume(failed, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, fault.name());
            check(failed.image().inbox().isEmpty() && failed.image().effects().isEmpty(), "rollback " + fault);
            passed("no ACK/no committed inbox on " + fault);
        }
        MemoryTransactions uncertain = new MemoryTransactions(2); uncertain.inject(Fault.LOST_COMMIT_REPLY);
        check(consume(uncertain, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK unknown"); }) == Outcome.COMMIT_UNKNOWN, "unknown");
        MemoryTransactions restarted = new MemoryTransactions(2, uncertain.image());
        check(consume(restarted, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "recover");
        check(restarted.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "recovery no effect replay");
        passed("lost commit reply UNKNOWN; simulated restart recovers same committed receipt");
        for (Plan plan : new Plan[]{Plan.RETRY_TASK, Plan.QUARANTINE_TASK}) {
            MemoryTransactions handoff = new MemoryTransactions(2); handoff.inject(Fault.HANDOFF);
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { throw new AssertionError("must not ACK failed handoff"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "handoff failure");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().isEmpty(), "failed handoff retained upstream");
            check(consume(handoff, message, plan, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED, "handoff confirmed");
            check(handoff.image().tasks().get(message.key()).externalRequestIdentity().equals(message.key()), "stable request identity");
            passed(plan + " failure retains upstream responsibility; success commits task");
        }
        MemoryTransactions ackFailure = new MemoryTransactions(2);
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new Exception("transport"); }) == Outcome.ACK_UNKNOWN, "ack error");
        check(consume(ackFailure, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { }) == Outcome.ACKED && ackFailure.image().effects().get(message.key()) == 1, "ack redelivery");
        passed("ACK transport failure never repeats committed effect");
        consume(database, msg("tenant-b", "notifications", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        consume(database, msg("tenant-a", "audit", "event-1", "canonical-v1"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(database.image().effects().size() == 3, "namespace independence"); passed("tenants and consumers independent");
        MemoryTransactions full = new MemoryTransactions(1);
        consume(full, message, Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { });
        check(consume(full, msg("t", "c", "e", "p"), Plan.LOCAL_EFFECT, () -> { throw new AssertionError("capacity ACK"); }) == Outcome.NOT_COMMITTED, "capacity");
        passed("bounded capacity rejects without ACK or eviction");
    }
}

运行：保存为 InboxModel.java；使用 JDK 21 执行 javac -Xlint:all -Werror InboxModel.java，再执行 java InboxModel。测试断言覆盖并发重复、payload 冲突、插入后回滚、效果失败、数据库错误、提交响应丢失、重试/隔离失败、ACK 失败、租户/消费者隔离和容量。核心不变量：一次不可变 State 发布同时带上 inbox、效果/责任与原始结果；ACK 使用独立异常边界。

records.before:
这是典型业务治理题。面试官看的是你是否能把“消息优先级、队列积压、渠道健康度、滑动窗口去重”串成闭环，而不是只说加 MQ。

核心目标是：关键告警优先触达，低价值重复消息合并或延迟，渠道故障时自动降级，系统整体不被噪声流量压垮。
records.after:
单纯先进先出会让关键告警排在大量重复上报后面；只按最高优先级取，又可能饿死低优任务。我会分别处理噪声合并、公平调度与渠道容量，并保留每个已受理任务的去向。

核心目标是：关键告警优先触达，低价值重复消息合并或延迟，渠道故障时自动降级，系统整体不被噪声流量压垮。

entryIdentity.title: 优先级调度与削峰去重

records.before:
推荐设计：

  1. 事件接入后标准化为统一模型：eventId、bizType、deviceId、priority、dedupKey、deadline、payload。
  2. 噪声合并层按受信 tenantId、bizType、deviceId、ruleId、alertRound、state、severity 组成有明确字段边界的 aggregationKey，限定同一告警轮次、状态与严重程度的合并窗口；统一事件模型中的 dedupKey 仅是这个聚合身份的兼容名称，不是业务幂等键；下面使用有类型边界的 Key。
  3. 调度层在有界任务存储中按 P0/P1/P2 取得原子 claim；8:3:1 是每轮尝试机会而非成功发送比例。端口调用有界、时间推进且持续运行时，低优先级仍获机会；同级轮转避免受限热渠道长期占头。
  4. 限流层根据渠道健康度动态调整发送速率。
  5. 明确未发送才延期重试；UNKNOWN 保留同一发送身份向权威渠道核对，不盲目换渠道。超过尝试阈值 PARKED/死信仍须保留恢复责任，不能删除待办。
  6. 状态机记录 RECEIVED、DEDUPED、QUEUED、SENT、ACKED、FAILED、DEAD。

采用首次事件起算的固定 60 秒窗口，不是滑动窗口。下面是完整 Java 21 内存聚合模型：计数与首次 expiry 在同一同步操作内更新；不提供未测试的 Redis Lua 或数据库适配器。

AggregationModel.java
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.Set;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;

/** Fixed FIRST-event 60-second windows, NOT sliding windows or durable business idempotency. */
public final class AggregationModel {
    private AggregationModel() { }
    static final long TTL = 60_000;
    record Key(String tenant, String businessType, String device, String rule, String round, String state, String severity) {
        Key { for (String v : new String[]{tenant, businessType, device, rule, round, state, severity}) text(v); }
    }
    record WindowId(Key key, long firstAt) { }
    record Window(WindowId id, long expiresAt, Set<String> events) {
        Window { events = Set.copyOf(events); }
        int count() { return events.size(); }
    }
    record Observation(boolean accepted, boolean firstInWindow, int count, long expiresAt) { }
    record Image(List<Window> windows) { Image { windows = List.copyOf(windows); } }
    static final class MemoryWindows {
        private final int capacity, eventLimit;
        private final Map<WindowId, Window> windows = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        MemoryWindows(int capacity, int eventLimit) { this(capacity, eventLimit, new Image(List.of())); }
        MemoryWindows(int capacity, int eventLimit, Image image) {
            if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 256 || eventLimit < 1 || eventLimit > 256 || image.windows().size() > capacity)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
            this.capacity = capacity; this.eventLimit = eventLimit;
            for (Window window : image.windows()) windows.put(window.id(), window);
        }
        synchronized Image image() { return new Image(new ArrayList<>(windows.values())); }
        synchronized Observation observe(Key key, String eventId, long now) {
            Objects.requireNonNull(key); text(eventId);
            if (now < 0 || now > Long.MAX_VALUE - TTL) throw new IllegalArgumentException("time");
            Window active = null;
            for (Window w : windows.values()) if (w.id().key().equals(key) && w.id().firstAt() <= now && now < w.expiresAt()) active = w;
            if (active != null) {
                if (active.events().contains(eventId)) return new Observation(true, false, active.count(), active.expiresAt());
                if (active.count() == eventLimit) return new Observation(false, false, active.count(), active.expiresAt());
                Set<String> events = new HashSet<>(active.events()); events.add(eventId);
                Window updated = new Window(active.id(), active.expiresAt(), events);
                windows.put(updated.id(), updated); // Counter and first-event expiry publish atomically under one monitor.
                return new Observation(true, false, updated.count(), updated.expiresAt());
            }
            if (windows.size() == capacity) return new Observation(false, false, 0, 0); // No eviction of unflushed summary.
            Window created = new Window(new WindowId(key, now), now + TTL, Set.of(eventId));
            windows.put(created.id(), created);
            return new Observation(true, true, 1, created.expiresAt());
        }
        synchronized List<Window> due(long now) {
            return windows.values().stream().filter(w -> w.expiresAt() <= now).toList();
        }
        synchronized void confirmSummary(Window committed, long now) {
            // Caller may invoke ONLY after stable WindowId summary responsibility was accepted by authoritative task store.
            // Failed/unknown handoff => do not call; retain window and retry using the SAME WindowId.
            Window current = windows.get(committed.id());
            if (current != null && current.equals(committed) && current.expiresAt() <= now) windows.remove(committed.id());
        }
    }
    static void text(String value) { if (value == null || value.isEmpty() || value.length() > 128) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text"); }
    static Key key(String round, String severity) { return new Key("tenant", "alarm", "device", "rule", round, "OPEN", severity); }
    static void check(boolean condition, String name) { if (!condition) throw new AssertionError(name); }
    static void pass(String name) { System.out.println("PASS " + name); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Key k = key("round-1", "WARN"); MemoryWindows store = new MemoryWindows(8, 128);
        Observation first = store.observe(k, "event-1", 100);
        check(first.firstInWindow() && first.count() == 1 && first.expiresAt() == 60_100, "first fixed TTL");
        check(store.observe(k, "event-1", 200).count() == 1, "duplicate observation");
        Observation second = store.observe(k, "event-2", 60_099);
        check(!second.firstInWindow() && second.count() == 2 && second.expiresAt() == 60_100, "expiry never extended");
        check(store.observe(key("round-2", "WARN"), "event-3", 200).firstInWindow(), "new round");
        check(store.observe(key("round-1", "CRITICAL"), "event-4", 200).firstInWindow(), "severity upgrade");
        check(store.observe(k, "event-5", 60_100).firstInWindow(), "exact TTL starts new window");
        pass("same-round duplicate, new round, severity upgrade, exact first-event TTL boundary");
        MemoryWindows concurrent = new MemoryWindows(2, 128); CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        AtomicReference<Throwable> error = new AtomicReference<>(); List<Thread> threads = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int n = 0; n < 8; n++) {
            final int worker = n;
            Thread thread = new Thread(() -> {
                try { check(start.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "start gate");
                    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) check(concurrent.observe(k, worker + ":" + i, 100).accepted(), "accepted concurrent event");
                } catch (Throwable ex) { error.compareAndSet(null, ex); }
            }); threads.add(thread); thread.start();
        }
        start.countDown(); for (Thread thread : threads) { thread.join(3000); check(!thread.isAlive(), "bounded join"); }
        if (error.get() != null) throw new AssertionError("concurrent writer failed", error.get());
        Window aggregate = concurrent.image().windows().getFirst();
        check(aggregate.count() == 64 && aggregate.expiresAt() == 60_100, "atomic count/expiry");
        pass("concurrent increment/expiry atomicity: 64 distinct events, one fixed expiry");
        MemoryWindows resumed = new MemoryWindows(2, 128, concurrent.image());
        check(resumed.observe(k, "0:0", 200).count() == 64, "simulated restart retains counter/expiry");
        List<Window> due = resumed.due(60_100); check(due.size() == 1, "summary due");
        check(resumed.due(60_101).equals(due), "failed/unknown summary handoff retains responsibility");
        resumed.confirmSummary(due.getFirst(), 60_100); resumed.confirmSummary(due.getFirst(), 60_100);
        check(resumed.image().windows().isEmpty(), "confirmed summary removed once");
        pass("simulated restart; summary responsibility retained until explicit confirmed handoff");
        MemoryWindows limited = new MemoryWindows(1, 1); limited.observe(k, "one", 0);
        check(!limited.observe(k, "two", 1).accepted(), "event cap keeps caller ownership");
        check(!limited.observe(key("new", "WARN"), "one", 1).accepted(), "window cap no eviction");
        check(!limited.observe(k, "new-window", TTL).accepted(), "expired unflushed summary not evicted");
        check(new MemoryWindows(1, 1).observe(k, "one", 1).firstInWindow(), "empty process loses suppression as documented");
        pass("bounds refuse admission, never evict; fresh-process loss explicitly demonstrated");
    }
}

仅对同一受信租户、告警轮次、状态和严重程度的重复噪声，才可按产品策略在 60 秒合并窗口内更新聚合计数；新一轮告警、状态变化或严重程度变化不能仅因仍在窗口内就被抑制。业务幂等由稳定 eventId 与权威效果记录裁决，渠道发送另有发送身份与回执。下方契约区分这三类身份；聚合摘要在稳定 WindowId 的责任转交确认前继续保留。Java 快照恢复只模拟存活存储，不能证明真实进程重启、Redis 淘汰或掉电恢复。

aggregation-contract.txt
原子聚合契约（说明文本，不是 Redis 命令）：
Key = (tenant, businessType, device, rule, alertRound, state, severity)
Window = [firstAt, firstAt + 60000ms)；后续事件不续期
同一窗口内：重复 eventId 不加计数；新 eventId 原子更新计数且保留首次到期时间
到期窗口保持摘要责任；稳定 WindowId 已确认交给权威任务存储后才可删除
容量满或交接失败：拒绝新接入/保留旧责任，绝不静默淘汰
Redis 若用于生产，必须另测原子脚本、TTL、重启/淘汰边界；本 Java 程序没有验证 Redis

可运行的有界 claim 调度模型：任务不从存储中 poll 删除。限流拒绝写 nextReadyAt 并释放 claim；租约到期、发送异常或超时均先保留 UNKNOWN，只有权威结果才推进。完整程序含有限周期驱动、10ms 等待、停止/中断、最大 3 次发送尝试及实际并发测试。每轮最多 12 次 claim 与 12 次核对，存储最多 256 条且不淘汰回执；满额由调用者继续持有。Channel/限流端口须有限时返回，参考内存渠道按同一 requestId 原子幂等接收与查询，不能无条件替换成任意真实 SDK。SENT 表示接受责任，不保证最终用户收件。噪声合并不替代业务幂等。

SchedulerModel.java
import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import java.util.Objects;
import java.util.concurrent.CountDownLatch;
import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicReference;
import java.util.function.LongSupplier;

/** Bounded Java 21 claim-store simulation. There is NO durable disk, Redis or real channel adapter. */
public final class SchedulerModel {
    private SchedulerModel() { }
    static final long BACKOFF = 20, LEASE = 100;
    static final int MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS = 3;
    enum Status { READY, CLAIMED, UNKNOWN, DONE, PARKED }
    enum Result { SENT, NOT_SENT, UNKNOWN }
    record Work(String tenant, String id, String channel, String payload, int priority) {
        Work { bounded(tenant); bounded(id); bounded(channel); bounded(payload);
            if (priority < 0 || priority > 2) throw new IllegalArgumentException("priority"); }
        String requestId() { return tenant.length() + ":" + tenant + id.length() + ":" + id; }
    }
    record Task(Work work, Status status, long readyAt, long leaseUntil, long token, int attempts) { }
    record Image(List<Task> tasks, long nextToken) { Image { tasks = List.copyOf(tasks); } }
    record Claim(Work work, long token) { }
    interface Limiter { boolean allow(String channel); }
    interface Channel {
        // Both calls must be bounded. UNKNOWN includes exceptions/timeouts; resolve must be authoritative.
        // SENT means accepted responsibility, not proof of end-user delivery. Same requestId, same payload.
        Result send(Work work) throws Exception;
        Result resolve(Work work) throws Exception;
    }
    interface Claims {
        Claim claim(int priority, long now);
        boolean beginSend(Claim claim);
        void finish(Claim claim, Result result, long now);
        List<Task> unknown(long now, int limit);
        void resolve(Task task, Result result, long now);
    }
    static final class MemoryClaims implements Claims {
        private final int capacity, maxClaims;
        private final LinkedHashMap<String, Task> tasks = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        private long nextToken;
        MemoryClaims(int capacity, int maxClaims) { this(capacity, maxClaims, new Image(List.of(), 0)); }
        MemoryClaims(int capacity, int maxClaims, Image image) {
            if (capacity < 1 || capacity > 256 || maxClaims < 1 || maxClaims > capacity || image.tasks().size() > capacity)
                throw new IllegalArgumentException("capacity");
            this.capacity = capacity; this.maxClaims = maxClaims; nextToken = image.nextToken();
            for (Task task : image.tasks()) tasks.put(task.work().requestId(), task);
        }
        synchronized boolean offer(Work work, long now) {
            time(now);
            Task old = tasks.get(work.requestId());
            if (old != null) {
                if (!old.work().equals(work)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("immutable identity conflict");
                return true;
            }
            if (tasks.size() == capacity) return false; // Caller retains unaccepted work; never evict.
            tasks.put(work.requestId(), new Task(work, Status.READY, now, 0, 0, 0)); return true;
        }
        synchronized Image image() { return new Image(new ArrayList<>(tasks.values()), nextToken); }
        synchronized Task get(Work work) { return tasks.get(work.requestId()); }
        private void rotate(Task task) { tasks.remove(task.work().requestId()); tasks.put(task.work().requestId(), task); }
        private void expire(long now) {
            time(now);
            for (Task task : new ArrayList<>(tasks.values())) if (task.status() == Status.CLAIMED && task.leaseUntil() <= now)
                rotate(new Task(task.work(), Status.UNKNOWN, now, 0, task.token(), task.attempts()));
            // Expiration NEVER assumes the previous sender did nothing. Reconcile before retry.
        }
        @Override public synchronized Claim claim(int priority, long now) {
            expire(now);
            long active = tasks.values().stream().filter(t -> t.status() == Status.CLAIMED).count();
            if (active >= maxClaims) return null;
            for (Task task : new ArrayList<>(tasks.values())) {
                if (task.status() == Status.READY && task.work().priority() == priority && task.readyAt() <= now) {
                    nextToken = Math.incrementExact(nextToken);
                    rotate(new Task(task.work(), Status.CLAIMED, task.readyAt(), now + LEASE, nextToken, task.attempts()));
                    return new Claim(task.work(), nextToken);
                }
            }
            return null;
        }
        @Override public synchronized boolean beginSend(Claim claim) {
            Task task = tasks.get(claim.work().requestId());
            if (task.status() != Status.CLAIMED || task.token() != claim.token()) return false;
            if (task.attempts() >= MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS) {
                rotate(new Task(task.work(), Status.PARKED, 0, 0, task.token(), task.attempts())); return false;
            }
            rotate(new Task(task.work(), task.status(), task.readyAt(), task.leaseUntil(), task.token(), task.attempts() + 1));
            return true;
        }
        @Override public synchronized void finish(Claim claim, Result result, long now) {
            time(now); Task task = tasks.get(claim.work().requestId());
            if (task.status() != Status.CLAIMED || task.token() != claim.token()) return; // Fence stale worker.
            settle(task, result, now);
        }
        private void settle(Task task, Result result, long now) {
            Status status = switch (result) {
                case SENT -> Status.DONE;
                case UNKNOWN -> Status.UNKNOWN;
                case NOT_SENT -> task.attempts() >= MAX_SEND_ATTEMPTS ? Status.PARKED : Status.READY;
            };
            rotate(new Task(task.work(), status, now + BACKOFF, 0, task.token(), task.attempts()));
        }
        @Override public synchronized List<Task> unknown(long now, int limit) {
            expire(now);
            List<Task> found = new ArrayList<>();
            for (Task task : new ArrayList<>(tasks.values())) {
                if (found.size() == limit) break;
                if (task.status() == Status.UNKNOWN && task.readyAt() <= now) { found.add(task); rotate(task); }
            }
            return List.copyOf(found);
        }
        @Override public synchronized void resolve(Task observed, Result result, long now) {
            time(now); Task current = tasks.get(observed.work().requestId());
            if (current.status() == Status.UNKNOWN && current.token() == observed.token()) settle(current, result, now);
        }
    }
    static final class Worker {
        private final Claims store; private final Channel channel; private final Limiter limiter;
        private volatile boolean stopped;
        Worker(Claims store, Channel channel, Limiter limiter) {
            this.store = store; this.channel = channel; this.limiter = limiter;
        }
        void stop() { stopped = true; }
        int cycle(long now) {
            if (stopped || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) return 0;
            int attempts = 0;
            for (Task task : store.unknown(now, 12)) {
                if (stopped || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) return attempts;
                Result result;
                try { result = Objects.requireNonNull(channel.resolve(task.work())); }
                catch (Exception ex) { result = Result.UNKNOWN; if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
                store.resolve(task, result, now);
            }
            int[] weights = {8, 3, 1}; // Slots count CLAIM ATTEMPTS, not successful sends.
            for (int priority = 0; priority < weights.length; priority++) {
                for (int slot = 0; slot < weights[priority]; slot++) {
                    if (stopped || Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) return attempts;
                    Claim claim = store.claim(priority, now);
                    if (claim == null) break;
                    attempts++;
                    Result result;
                    try {
                        if (!limiter.allow(claim.work().channel())) result = Result.NOT_SENT;
                        else if (!store.beginSend(claim)) continue;
                        else result = Objects.requireNonNull(channel.send(claim.work()));
                    } catch (Exception ex) {
                        result = Result.UNKNOWN;
                        if (ex instanceof InterruptedException) Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
                    }
                    store.finish(claim, result, now); // Claimed record never disappears during deny/error/stop.
                }
            }
            return attempts;
        }
        void run(int maxCycles, LongSupplier clock) throws InterruptedException {
            if (maxCycles < 0) throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxCycles");
            for (int i = 0; i < maxCycles && !stopped; i++) {
                if (Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted()) throw new InterruptedException("worker interrupted");
                cycle(clock.getAsLong());
                Thread.sleep(10); // At most 100 bounded cycles/sec even with empty/denied queues.
            }
        }
    }
    /** Reference channel has permanent same-key idempotency up to capacity; only in-memory. */
    static final class MemoryChannel implements Channel {
        final Map<String, Work> accepted = new LinkedHashMap<>();
        Result next = Result.SENT;
        boolean throwAfterAccept, interrupt;
        @Override public synchronized Result send(Work work) throws Exception {
            if (interrupt) { interrupt = false; throw new InterruptedException("bounded read interrupted"); }
            Work old = accepted.get(work.requestId());
            if (old != null && !old.equals(work)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("channel identity conflict");
            if (old != null) return Result.SENT;
            if (accepted.size() == 256) return Result.NOT_SENT;
            Result result = next; next = Result.SENT;
            if (result != Result.NOT_SENT) accepted.put(work.requestId(), work);
            if (throwAfterAccept) { throwAfterAccept = false; throw new Exception("reply lost after accept"); }
            return result;
        }
        @Override public synchronized Result resolve(Work work) {
            Work old = accepted.get(work.requestId());
            if (old != null && !old.equals(work)) throw new IllegalArgumentException("channel identity conflict");
            return old == null ? Result.NOT_SENT : Result.SENT;
        }
    }
    static Work work(String id, int priority, String channel) { return new Work("tenant", id, channel, "payload", priority); }
    static void bounded(String text) { if (text == null || text.isEmpty() || text.length() > 256) throw new IllegalArgumentException("text bound"); }
    static void time(long now) { if (now < 0 || now > Long.MAX_VALUE - 1000) throw new IllegalArgumentException("time"); }
    static void check(boolean ok, String name) { if (!ok) throw new AssertionError(name); }
    static void pass(String name) { System.out.println("PASS " + name); }
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Work one = work("one", 0, "email"); MemoryClaims store = new MemoryClaims(64, 2); store.offer(one, 0);
        MemoryChannel channel = new MemoryChannel(); Worker denied = new Worker(store, channel, c -> false);
        check(denied.cycle(0) == 1 && store.get(one).status() == Status.READY, "denial retained");
        check(denied.cycle(19) == 0 && store.get(one).attempts() == 0, "defer no busy retry");
        Worker worker = new Worker(store, channel, c -> true); worker.cycle(20); worker.cycle(40);
        check(channel.accepted.size() == 1 && store.get(one).status() == Status.DONE, "eventual once"); pass("denial retained, eligible at boundary, sent once");
        for (boolean throwing : new boolean[]{false, true}) {
            long at = throwing ? 100 : 50;
            Work uncertain = work("unknown" + throwing, 0, "email"); store.offer(uncertain, at);
            channel.next = Result.UNKNOWN; channel.throwAfterAccept = throwing; worker.cycle(at);
            check(store.get(uncertain).status() == Status.UNKNOWN, "unknown retained");
            worker.cycle(at + BACKOFF); check(store.get(uncertain).status() == Status.DONE && store.get(uncertain).attempts() == 1, "resolve no resend");
            pass(throwing ? "send throws after acceptance; reconcile stable identity" : "unknown send response; reconcile stable identity");
        }
        Work changed = new Work(one.tenant(), one.id(), one.channel(), "changed-payload", one.priority());
        try { store.offer(changed, 140); throw new AssertionError("changed identity accepted"); }
        catch (IllegalArgumentException expected) { check(expected.getMessage().contains("identity"), "store conflict"); }
        MemoryClaims freshStore = new MemoryClaims(1, 1); freshStore.offer(changed, 140);
        Worker conflicting = new Worker(freshStore, channel, c -> true); conflicting.cycle(140); conflicting.cycle(160);
        check(freshStore.get(changed).status() == Status.UNKNOWN, "channel conflict not mistaken for sent");
        pass("immutable request payload checked by task store and channel recovery");
        MemoryClaims concurrent = new MemoryClaims(4, 2); concurrent.offer(one, 0);
        MemoryChannel concurrentChannel = new MemoryChannel(); CountDownLatch start = new CountDownLatch(1);
        AtomicReference<Throwable> failure = new AtomicReference<>(); List<Thread> senders = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
            Thread sender = new Thread(() -> {
                try { check(start.await(2, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "sender start");
                    new Worker(concurrent, concurrentChannel, c -> true).cycle(0);
                } catch (Throwable ex) { failure.compareAndSet(null, ex); }
            }); senders.add(sender); sender.start();
        }
        start.countDown(); for (Thread sender : senders) { sender.join(2000); check(!sender.isAlive(), "sender finished"); }
        if (failure.get() != null) throw new AssertionError("concurrent sender", failure.get());
        check(concurrent.get(one).attempts() == 1 && concurrentChannel.accepted.size() == 1, "one concurrent claim/send");
        pass("two concurrent workers claim and accept one task once");
        MemoryClaims unresolved = new MemoryClaims(1, 1); unresolved.offer(one, 0);
        Channel blackHole = new Channel() {
            @Override public Result send(Work work) throws Exception { throw new Exception("unknown before observed acceptance"); }
            @Override public Result resolve(Work work) { return Result.UNKNOWN; }
        };
        Worker uncertainWorker = new Worker(unresolved, blackHole, c -> true);
        uncertainWorker.cycle(0); uncertainWorker.cycle(20); uncertainWorker.cycle(40);
        check(unresolved.get(one).status() == Status.UNKNOWN && unresolved.get(one).attempts() == 1, "unresolved retained without blind resend");
        pass("unresolved channel result stays owned and UNKNOWN without destination or identity change");
        MemoryClaims full = new MemoryClaims(2, 1); Work a = work("a", 0, "x"), b = work("b", 0, "x");
        check(full.offer(a, 0) && full.offer(b, 0) && !full.offer(work("c", 0, "x"), 0), "full caller owns c");
        Claim lease = full.claim(0, 0); check(lease != null && full.claim(0, 0) == null, "claim capacity");
        MemoryClaims resumed = new MemoryClaims(2, 1, full.image());
        Worker recovered = new Worker(resumed, new MemoryChannel(), c -> true); recovered.cycle(LEASE);
        check(resumed.get(a).status() == Status.READY, "expired claim reconciled NOT_SENT with delay");
        recovered.cycle(LEASE + BACKOFF); check(resumed.get(a).status() == Status.DONE && resumed.get(b).status() == Status.DONE, "restart tasks survive snapshot");
        resumed.finish(lease, Result.UNKNOWN, LEASE + BACKOFF); check(resumed.get(a).status() == Status.DONE, "old claim fenced");
        pass("queue/claim capacity, simulated store restart, lease ambiguity and stale worker fencing");
        MemoryClaims fair = new MemoryClaims(128, 1); MemoryChannel fairChannel = new MemoryChannel();
        Worker fairWorker = new Worker(fair, fairChannel, c -> !c.equals("hot"));
        for (int round = 0; round < 5; round++) {
            for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) fair.offer(work("high" + round + ":" + i, 0, "hot"), round * 20L);
            Work middle = work("mid" + round, 1, "ok"), low = work("low" + round, 2, "ok");
            fair.offer(middle, round * 20L); fair.offer(low, round * 20L);
            check(fairWorker.cycle(round * 20L) <= 12, "bounded cycle");
            check(fair.get(middle).status() == Status.DONE && fair.get(low).status() == Status.DONE, "low progress");
        }
        Work peer = work("same-priority-permitted", 0, "ok"); fair.offer(peer, 100);
        for (int i = 0; i < 6; i++) fairWorker.cycle(100 + i * 20L);
        check(fair.get(peer).status() == Status.DONE, "rotation past denied hot tasks");
        pass("sustained high load permits low priority; denied hot channel cannot monopolize attempts");
        MemoryClaims stoppedStore = new MemoryClaims(4, 1); stoppedStore.offer(one, 0);
        Worker stopped = new Worker(stoppedStore, new MemoryChannel(), c -> true); stopped.stop();
        check(stopped.cycle(0) == 0 && stoppedStore.get(one).status() == Status.READY, "shutdown retained");
        MemoryChannel interruptedChannel = new MemoryChannel(); interruptedChannel.interrupt = true;
        Worker interrupted = new Worker(stoppedStore, interruptedChannel, c -> true); interrupted.cycle(0);
        check(Thread.currentThread().isInterrupted() && stoppedStore.get(one).status() == Status.UNKNOWN, "interrupt retained unknown");
        Thread.interrupted();
        CountDownLatch began = new CountDownLatch(1); Thread sleeper = new Thread(() -> {
            try { began.countDown(); new Worker(new MemoryClaims(1, 1), new MemoryChannel(), c -> true).run(1000, () -> 0); }
            catch (InterruptedException ex) { Thread.currentThread().interrupt(); }
        });
        sleeper.start(); check(began.await(1, TimeUnit.SECONDS), "worker started"); sleeper.interrupt(); sleeper.join(1000);
        check(!sleeper.isAlive(), "bounded interruption"); pass("shutdown and interruption retain task ownership; idle loop is paced");
        MemoryClaims exhausted = new MemoryClaims(1, 1); exhausted.offer(one, 0); MemoryChannel refusing = new MemoryChannel();
        Worker retry = new Worker(exhausted, refusing, c -> true);
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) { refusing.next = Result.NOT_SENT; retry.cycle(i * BACKOFF); }
        check(exhausted.get(one).status() == Status.PARKED && exhausted.image().tasks().size() == 1, "attempt cap retains responsibility");
        pass("attempt budget parks owned task without dropping it");
    }
}

运行：两个文件分别保存为 AggregationModel.java 和 SchedulerModel.java；JDK 21 执行 javac -Xlint:all -Werror AggregationModel.java SchedulerModel.java，再分别运行 java AggregationModel 与 java SchedulerModel。仅标准库。聚合每字段 1..128 UTF-16 单元、最多 256 窗口×256 事件；调度每字段 1..256 单元、时间输入单调且保留溢出余量。快照只接受同实现生成的可信 Image。聚合摘要仅在权威任务存储确认同一 WindowId 的责任后删除；UNKNOWN 保留。两个模型分别演示聚合和已接纳任务调度，不声称二者与真实数据库/Redis/外部渠道构成一个事务。进程内模型没有磁盘持久化，真实进程丢失会丢状态。

模型前提：调用方提供同一业务身份不回退的权威逻辑时间；回收摘要后也不可重放旧时间创建同一 WindowId。cycle(now) 将这一轮视为单一逻辑时刻，不模拟真实 I/O 中时钟推进。真实端口必须在每次领取、发送前和提交时重新读取权威时间并校验租约/代际，渠道同身份幂等仍独立必要。可信 Image 只接受本实现快照，不接受任意外部反序列化数据。
